thaumcraft_01.golem.head.text.smart_scout: Using both biothaumic eyes and brain, this head is the pinnacle of the biothaumic art.
thaumcraft_01.golem.leg.text.climber: A pair of simple legs enhanced with crampons and other devices allowing for vertical ascent.
thaumcraft_01.golem.leg.text.flyer: A modified arcane levitator granting the golem the power of flight. Reduces speed by a third.
thaumcraft_01.golem.leg.text.roller: A single wheel. Quite fast, but incapable of jumping or going up steep hills.
thaumcraft_01.golem.leg.text.walker: A pair of simple legs. No particular strengths or weaknesses.
thaumcraft_01.golem.material.text.brass: The golem is crafted from brass. It is not as sturdy as iron nor as resistant to fire. Normally brass is heavier than iron, but it allows for superior construction methods which results in a much lighter frame.
thaumcraft_01.golem.material.text.clay: The golem is crafted from baked clay. It is not a particularly sturdy material, but the resulting golem is fireproof and relatively light.
thaumcraft_01.golem.material.text.iron: The golem is crafted from iron. It is sturdy and fireproof, but heavy.
thaumcraft_01.golem.material.text.thaumium: The golem is crafted from thaumium. It shares many characteristics with iron, though it is sturdier and more resistant to damage.
thaumcraft_01.golem.material.text.void: The golem is crafted from void metal. Slightly softer than iron, this metal makes up for it by being lighter and able to repair itself.
thaumcraft_01.golem.material.text.wood: The golem is crafted from greatwood. It is light and agile, but not particularly sturdy.
thaumcraft_01.golem.prop.lock: Only golems owned by seal owner can perform these tasks
thaumcraft_01.golem.prop.unlock: All golems can perform these tasks
thaumcraft_01.golem.trait.text.armored: The golem is reinforced with additional material which increases its armor rating. Counters and countered by Fragile.
thaumcraft_01.golem.trait.text.blastproof: The golem is highly resistant to explosion damage.
thaumcraft_01.golem.trait.text.breaker: The golem is capable of destroying most blocks with ease.
thaumcraft_01.golem.trait.text.brutal: The golem inflicts greater melee damage in combat.
thaumcraft_01.golem.trait.text.climber: Sheer cliffs do not deter this golem. It can easily scale them to get to its destination.
thaumcraft_01.golem.trait.text.clumsy: This golem has almost no manual dexterity and can only perform simple tasks requiring basic interactions. Counters and countered by Deft.
thaumcraft_01.golem.trait.text.deft: This golem has a great deal of manual dexterity and can perform tasks requiring precision and a delicate touch. Counters and countered by Clumsy.
thaumcraft_01.golem.trait.text.fighter: The golem is capable of taking hostile action against other entities.
thaumcraft_01.golem.trait.text.fireproof: The golem is immune to fire damage.
thaumcraft_01.golem.trait.text.flyer: The golem is capable of flight, giving it greater mobility at the cost of speed.
thaumcraft_01.golem.trait.text.fragile: The golem is built with delicate components or weak materials that reduce its life total and armour rating. Counters and countered by Armored.
thaumcraft_01.golem.trait.text.hauler: Allows the golem to carry two stack of items instead of one.
thaumcraft_01.golem.trait.text.heavy: The golem is heavier than average, which reduces its speed and agility. Counters and countered by Light.
thaumcraft_01.golem.trait.text.light: The golem is lighter than average, which gives it increased speed and agility. Counters and countered by Heavy.
thaumcraft_01.golem.trait.text.ranged: The golem can attack targets at range.
thaumcraft_01.golem.trait.text.repair: The golem repairs any damage suffered at more than double the normal rate.
thaumcraft_01.golem.trait.text.scout: The golem has a greater visual range and can operate in a much wider area: 48 blocks away from its home location, instead of 32.
thaumcraft_01.golem.trait.text.smart: This golem is nearly sentient, with superior reasoning and decision-making capabilities.
thaumcraft_01.golem.trait.text.wheeled: The golem propels itself using wheels. This gives it greater speed, but it is unable to jump or navigate steep slopes.
thaumcraft_01.got.crystals: Your fingers tingle strangely as you handle the crystal. What does that mean? Maybe some rest will inspire you.
thaumcraft_01.got.deepdown: You have visited deep and dark depths and have learned much.
thaumcraft_01.got.dream: You awaken from a strange dream. You quickly write it down before the memory fades.
thaumcraft_01.got.finddesert: You have visited the scorching desert.
thaumcraft_01.got.findocean: You have peered into the endless blue abyss.
thaumcraft_01.got.instability: You should study infusion instability further.
thaumcraft_01.got.onfire: You have felt the touch of flame.
thaumcraft_01.got.pechwand: Hmm, curious. You should investigate this further.
thaumcraft_01.got.projectile: You learn some more about projectiles.
thaumcraft_01.got.uphigh: The world is spread out before you. Your perspective has been broadened.
thaumcraft_01.not.pechwand: You cannot fathom the workings of this yet.
thaumcraft_01.research.METALPURIFICATION.stage.2: I have formulated an alchemical recipe to purify metal ores into native clusters, as I was hoping. As mentioned previously, smelting these produces twice the number of ingots than a regular piece of ore - this should help me avoid continually delving into the depths on mining expeditions. The recipe itself is versatile, and should work for many kinds of metal ore if I have access to them.
thaumcraft_01.tc.addclue: §aYou have discovered something that could aid future research§0
thaumcraft_01.tc.aspect.name: Aspects of Essentia
thaumcraft_01.tc.boss.crimson: A ruby portal opens nearby, heralding the arrival of the Crimson Cult. You must close the portal quickly!
thaumcraft_01.tc.boss.enrage: is enraged by your powerful blows.
thaumcraft_01.tc.boss.golem: A lone sentinel stands frozen in this room, but as energy starts crackling through its ancient frame, you know it will not stay frozen for long.
thaumcraft_01.tc.boss.taint: An organic rustling comes from the room beyond. The sound of something... wrong. Something growing...
thaumcraft_01.tc.boss.warden: Black energy bubbles on the distant pedestal. Something is coming...
thaumcraft_01.tc.break.fly: Something disrupts your ability to fly.
thaumcraft_01.tc.celestial.fail.1: You have already studied that today.
thaumcraft_01.tc.celestial.fail.2: You are unable to take notes of your studies.
thaumcraft_01.tc.discoveryerror: To understand this you need to study %1$s.
thaumcraft_01.tc.fluxevent.1: The nearby aura suddenly twists and warps, leaving your thoughts in a shambles.
thaumcraft_01.tc.fluxevent.2: The local aura momentarily becomes unstable, hampering your magical ability.
thaumcraft_01.tc.fluxevent.3: It seems that there is too much flux in the local aura!
thaumcraft_01.tc.handmirrorerror: Destination mirror is missing or misplaced. Link broken.
thaumcraft_01.tc.invtoolarge: Inventory too large. Only scanning first 100 items.
thaumcraft_01.tc.lootbag: Click to open, or keep to trade.
thaumcraft_01.tc.need.craft: Items that need to be crafted
thaumcraft_01.tc.need.research: Things that need to be discovered
thaumcraft_01.tc.notowned: This does not belong to you.
thaumcraft_01.tc.search.more: ...too many results found. Refine your search
thaumcraft_01.tc.taint_item_poison: A dissolving %s has infected you with Taint
thaumcraft_01.tc.unknownobject: Nothing new can be learned from this.

thaumcraft_02.thaumcraft.AIR.text: Creates a blast of air that knocks things back, but causes only minor damage.
thaumcraft_02.thaumcraft.BOLT.text: Hurl magic directly at your target as a concentrated bolt of energy. The effect is instantaneous, but the range is limited to 16 blocks.
thaumcraft_02.thaumcraft.BREAK.text: Summons disruptive energy that breaks down most materials.
thaumcraft_02.thaumcraft.CLOUD.text: Creates a lingering cloud of magical energy that effects anything inside.
thaumcraft_02.thaumcraft.CURSE.text: Summons the powers of entropy to harm and disrupt the targeted creature.
thaumcraft_02.thaumcraft.EARTH.text: Hurls a blast of earthen shrapnel that causes significant damage and may break weaker blocks.
thaumcraft_02.thaumcraft.EXCHANGE.text: Swap one type of block in the world for another.
thaumcraft_02.thaumcraft.FIRE.text: Hurls flame at your target and sets it alight.
thaumcraft_02.thaumcraft.FLUX.text: This effect conjures raw, unfocused vis that disrupts living (and dead) creatures. This energy cannot interact with inanimate objects, but it does bypass mundane armor.
thaumcraft_02.thaumcraft.FROST.text: Throws chilling cold at your target, causing damage and freezing it. Freezes water and will slow down creatures.
thaumcraft_02.thaumcraft.HEAL.text: This effect heals living creatures and harms undead.
thaumcraft_02.thaumcraft.MINE.text: Creates a mystical construct that detonates when a hostile entity passes nearby, releasing the effects upon it.
thaumcraft_02.thaumcraft.PLAN.text: Allows you to plan exactly which blocks will be affected.
thaumcraft_02.thaumcraft.PROJECTILE.text: Gathers the energy of the focus into a magical orb that you can throw like a projectile. This projectile travels slowly and is affected by gravity.
thaumcraft_02.thaumcraft.RIFT.text: Shifts matter into an alternate reality, creating temporary 'holes' through which you can travel.
thaumcraft_02.thaumcraft.SCATTER.text: Split a single trajectory into multiple random trajectories.
thaumcraft_02.thaumcraft.SPELLBAT.text: Conjures a mystical bat that will hunt down enemies and inflict them with the focus's effects.
thaumcraft_02.thaumcraft.SPLITTARGET.text: Split a single target into two weaker ones.
thaumcraft_02.thaumcraft.SPLITTRAJECTORY.text: Split a single trajectory into two weaker ones.
thaumcraft_02.thaumcraft.TOUCH.text: Allows you to affect things you can touch, within roughly 4 blocks of the point of origin.
thaumcraft_02.warp.text.11: What was that noise? Something is behind you.
thaumcraft_02.warp.text.13: Something is watching you. Maybe it is time to stop.
thaumcraft_02.warp.text.14: You have a moment of clarity.
thaumcraft_02.warp.text.15: Your stomach suddenly gurgles very strangely.
thaumcraft_02.warp.text.16: The faint sound of chanting can be heard nearby.
thaumcraft_02.warp.text.2: A sudden and unnatural hunger consumes you.
thaumcraft_02.warp.text.3: Strange whispers reveal secrets to you.
thaumcraft_02.warp.text.4: Your vision becomes strange and grim.
thaumcraft_02.warp.text.5: The light suddenly becomes overwhelmingly bright and burns your skin.
thaumcraft_02.warp.text.6: A thick fog appears from nowhere. Something stirs in its depths.
thaumcraft_02.warp.text.8: Surely there must be a way to stop these headaches?
thaumcraft_02.warp.text.9: You suddenly feel reluctant to break things.
thaumcraft_02.warp.text.hunger.1: Your hunger cannot be satisfied with normal food.

abyssalcraft_01.ac.rending.essence_aw: Abyssal Wasteland Essences are made from harvesting Abyssal Wasteland Energy from Coralium entities.
abyssalcraft_01.ac.rending.essence_dl: Dreadlands Essences are made from harvesting Dreadlands Energy from Dread entities.
abyssalcraft_01.ac.rending.essence_omt: Omothol Essences are made from harvesting Omothol Energy from entities in Omothol.
abyssalcraft_01.ac.rending.shadowgem: Shadow Gems are made from harvesting Shadow Energy from living shadows.
abyssalcraft_01.ac.ritual.adurationCharm.desc: A Duration Azathoth Charm is made by infusion an Azathoth Charm with Redstone Dust and Shadow Fragments.
abyssalcraft_01.ac.ritual.altarOfChagarothBottom.desc: An Altar of Cha'garoth (bottom) is created with Dreadstone. Dreadium Ingots, Asorah's Dreaded Gateway Key, Bones and a piece of Dread Cloth.
abyssalcraft_01.ac.ritual.altarOfChagarothTop.desc: An Altar of Cha'garoth (top) is created with Sticks, a Bucket, Dread Cloths and Dreadium Ingots.
abyssalcraft_01.ac.ritual.antiPotionAoE.desc: Exposes nearby entities to Liquid Antimatter. Offer 4 Rotten Anti-Flesh, 3 Water Bottles and a piece of Gunpowder.
abyssalcraft_01.ac.ritual.apowerCharm.desc: A Power Azathoth Charm is made by infusion an Azathoth Charm with Glowstone Dust and Shadow Fragments.
abyssalcraft_01.ac.ritual.arangeCharm.desc: A Range Azathoth Charm is made by infusion an Azathoth Charm with Arrows and Shadow Fragments.
abyssalcraft_01.ac.ritual.asorahGatewayKey.desc: Asorah's Dreaded Gateway Key is created by infusing a Gateway Key with an Eye of The Abyss, a Dreadlands Infused Powerstone and a Transmutation Gem.
abyssalcraft_01.ac.ritual.azathothCharm.desc: An Azathoth Charm is made by infusing a Ritual Charm with Azathoth Engraved Coins.
abyssalcraft_01.ac.ritual.azathothStatue.desc: An Azathoth Statue is created by infusing a Monolith Stone with Shoggoth Flesh of The Overworld (normal), Abyssal Wasteland, Dreadlands, Omothol and The Dark Realm, an Abyssal Wasteland Essence, a Dreadlands Essence and an Omothol Essence.
abyssalcraft_01.ac.ritual.basicScroll.desc: A Basic Scroll is created with 4 Books
abyssalcraft_01.ac.ritual.breeding.desc: Breeds nearby animals. Might also kill all of them, if unlucky enough.
abyssalcraft_01.ac.ritual.cdurationCharm.desc: A Duration Cthulhu Charm is made by infusion a Cthulhu Charm with Redstone Dust and Shadow Fragments.
abyssalcraft_01.ac.ritual.cleansing.desc: By presenting 8 random statues, a massive amount of energy and a living sacrifice, you revert the corruption of the Abyss from the surrounding area. With far too much power comes no responsibilities, what so ever. It purges the Darklands, restoring it to its pure Overworld state.
abyssalcraft_01.ac.ritual.corEnchantment.desc: By combining an Abyssal Wasteland Essence, Abyssal Shoggoth Flesh, Refined Coralium Ingots, Coralium-plagued Flesh and a Book, you can enchant a weapon placed on the altar with the Coralium enchantment (if applicable).
abyssalcraft_01.ac.ritual.corPotionAoE.desc: Spreads the Coralium Plague to nearby entities. Offer 4 Coralium-plagued Flesh, 3 Water Bottles and a piece of Gunpowder.
abyssalcraft_01.ac.ritual.corruption.desc: By presenting 4 random statues, 4 blocks of Darkstone, a large amount of energy and a living sacrifice, you summon powers from the Abyss to corrupt the surrounding area. Defile the Overworld's purity in order to bring forth the Darklands.
abyssalcraft_01.ac.ritual.cpowerCharm.desc: A Power Cthulhu Charm is made by infusion a Cthulhu Charm with Glowstone Dust and Shadow Fragments.
abyssalcraft_01.ac.ritual.crangeCharm.desc: A Range Cthulhu Charm is made by infusion a Cthulhu Charm with Arrows and Shadow Fragments.
abyssalcraft_01.ac.ritual.cthulhuCharm.desc: A Cthulhu Charm is made by infusing a Ritual Charm with Cthulhu Engraved Coins.
abyssalcraft_01.ac.ritual.cthulhuStatue.desc: A Cthulhu Statue is created by infusing a Monolith Stone with Shoggoth Flesh, an Abyssal Wasteland Essence, a Dreadlands Essence and an Omothol Essence.
abyssalcraft_01.ac.ritual.curing.desc: By presenting 4 Dread Plague Antidotes, you cure the area of the Dread Plague and the Dreadlands, restoring what was there before. The closest non-dreadlands biome will take the place of the Dreadlands.
abyssalcraft_01.ac.ritual.depthsBoots.desc: Boots of The Depths are created by infusing a Refined Coralium Boots with 2 Coralium Gem Cluster (9 gems), Coralium-plagued Flesh, a Transmutation Gem, a Lily Pad, a Vine and a Liquid Coralium Bucket.
abyssalcraft_01.ac.ritual.depthsChestplate.desc: A Chestplate of The Depths is created by infusing a Refined Coralium Chestplate with 2 Coralium Gem Cluster (9 gems), Coralium-plagued Flesh, a Transmutation Gem, a Lily Pad, a Vine and a Liquid Coralium Bucket.
abyssalcraft_01.ac.ritual.depthsHelmet.desc: A Helmet of The Depths is created by infusing a Refined Coralium Helmet with 2 Coralium Gem Cluster (9 gems), Coralium-plagued Flesh, a Transmutation Gem, a Lily Pad, a Vine and a Liquid Coralium Bucket.
abyssalcraft_01.ac.ritual.depthsLeggings.desc: Leggings of The Depths are created by infusing a Refined Coralium Leggings with 2 Coralium Gem Cluster (9 gems), Coralium-plagued Flesh, a Transmutation Gem, a Lily Pad, a Vine and a Liquid Coralium Bucket.
abyssalcraft_01.ac.ritual.dreEnchantment.desc: By combining a Dreadlands Essence, Dreaded Shoggoth Flesh, Dreadium Ingots, Dread Fragments and a Book, you can enchant a weapon placed on the altar with the Dread enchantment (if applicable).
abyssalcraft_01.ac.ritual.drePotionAoE.desc: Spreads the Dread Plague to nearby entities. Offer 4 Dread Fragments, 3 Water Bottles and a piece of Gunpowder.
abyssalcraft_01.ac.ritual.dreadBoots.desc: Dreaded Abyssalnite Boots is created by infusing Abyssalnite Boots with Dreaded Shards of Abyssalnite and a Dreadlands Essence.
abyssalcraft_01.ac.ritual.dreadChestplate.desc: A Dreaded Abyssalnite Chestplate is created by infusing an Abyssalnite Chestplate with Dreaded Shards of Abyssalnite and a Dreadlands Essence.
abyssalcraft_01.ac.ritual.dreadHelmet.desc: A Dreaded Abyssalnite Helmet is created by infusing an Abyssalnite Helmet with Dreaded Shards of Abyssalnite and a Dreadlands Essence.
abyssalcraft_01.ac.ritual.dreadLeggings.desc: Dreaded Abyssalnite Leggings is created by infusing Abyssalnite Leggings with Dreaded Shards of Abyssalnite and a Dreadlands Essence.
abyssalcraft_01.ac.ritual.dreadSpawn.desc: All nearby Dread Spawns (regardless of evolution stage) is cloned to produce a double. Offer a Dread Fragment, a Dreadstone, an Abyssalnite Stone, a Chunk of Abyssalnite, a Dreaded Chunk of Abyssalnite, a piece of Rotten Flesh, a Dreaded Shard of Abyssalnite and an Abyssalnite Ingot.
abyssalcraft_01.ac.ritual.durationCharm.desc: A Duration Ritual Charm is made by infusion a Ritual Charm with Redstone Dust and Shadow Fragments.
abyssalcraft_01.ac.ritual.ecolAWupgrade.desc: An Abyssal Wasteland Energy Collector is created by infusing an Overworld Energy Collector with Abyssal Stone Bricks, Coralium Bricks, Shadow Gem Shards and Coralium Gems.
abyssalcraft_01.ac.ritual.ecolDLupgrade.desc: A Dreadlands Energy Collector is created by infusing an Abyssal Wasteland Energy Collector with Dreadstone Bricks, Abyssalnite Stone Bricks, Shadow Gem Shards and Coralium Gems.
abyssalcraft_01.ac.ritual.ecolOMTupgrade.desc: An Omothol Energy Collector is created by infusing a Dreadlands Energy Collector with Ethaxium Bricks, Dark Ethaxium Bricks, Shadow Gem Shards and Coralium Gems.
abyssalcraft_01.ac.ritual.ecolOWupgrade.desc: An Overworld Energy Collector is created by infusing an Energy Collector with Cobblestone, Darkstone Cobblestone, Shadow Gem Shards and Coralium Gems.
abyssalcraft_01.ac.ritual.econAWupgrade.desc: An Abyssal Wasteland Energy Container is created by infusing an Overworld Energy Container with Abyssal Stone Bricks, Coralium Bricks, Shadow Gem Shards and Coralium Gems.
abyssalcraft_01.ac.ritual.econDLupgrade.desc: A Dreadlands Energy Container is created by infusing an Abyssal Wasteland Energy Container with Dreadstone Bricks, Abyssalnite Stone Bricks, Shadow Gem Shards and Coralium Gems.

abyssalcraft_02.ac.ritual.econOMTupgrade.desc: An Omothol Energy Container is created by infusing a Dreadlands Energy Container with Ethaxium Bricks, Dark Ethaxium Bricks, Shadow Gem Shards and Coralium Gems.
abyssalcraft_02.ac.ritual.econOWupgrade.desc: An Overworld Energy Container is created by infusing an Energy Container with Cobblestone, Darkstone Cobblestone, Shadow Gem Shards and Coralium Gems.
abyssalcraft_02.ac.ritual.epAWupgrade.desc: An Abyssal Wasteland Energy Pedestal is created by infusing an Overworld Energy Pedestal with Abyssal Stone Bricks, Coralium Bricks, Shadow Gem Shards and Coralium Gems.
abyssalcraft_02.ac.ritual.epDLupgrade.desc: A Dreadlands Energy Pedestal is created by infusing an Abyssal Wasteland Energy Pedestal with Dreadstone Bricks, Abyssalnite Stone Bricks, Shadow Gem Shards and Coralium Gems.
abyssalcraft_02.ac.ritual.epOMTupgrade.desc: An Omothol Energy Pedestal is created by infusing a Dreadlands Energy Pedestal with Ethaxium Bricks, Dark Ethaxium Bricks, Shadow Gem Shards and Coralium Gems.
abyssalcraft_02.ac.ritual.epOWupgrade.desc: An Overworld Energy Pedestal is created by infusing an Energy Pedestal with Cobblestone, Darkstone Cobblestone, Shadow Gem Shards and Coralium Gems.
abyssalcraft_02.ac.ritual.erAWupgrade.desc: An Abyssal Wasteland Energy Relay is created by infusing an Overworld Energy Relay with Abyssal Stone Bricks, Coralium Bricks, Shadow Gem Shards and Coralium Gems.
abyssalcraft_02.ac.ritual.erDLupgrade.desc: A Dreadlands Energy Relay is created by infusing an Abyssal Wasteland Energy Relay with Dreadstone Bricks, Abyssalnite Stone Bricks, Shadow Gem Shards and Coralium Gems.
abyssalcraft_02.ac.ritual.erOMTupgrade.desc: An Omothol Energy Relay is created by infusing a Dreadlands Energy Relay with Ethaxium Bricks, Dark Ethaxium Bricks, Shadow Gem Shards and Coralium Gems.
abyssalcraft_02.ac.ritual.erOWupgrade.desc: An Overworld Energy Relay is created by infusing an Energy Relay with Cobblestone, Darkstone Cobblestone, Shadow Gem Shards and Coralium Gems.
abyssalcraft_02.ac.ritual.ethaxiumIngot.desc: An Ethaxium Ingot is created by Infusing a Life Crystal with Ethaxium Bricks.
abyssalcraft_02.ac.ritual.hasturCharm.desc: A Hastur Charm is made by infusing a Ritual Charm with Hastur Engraved Coins.
abyssalcraft_02.ac.ritual.hasturStatue.desc: A Hastur Statue is created by infusing a Monolith Stone with Abyssal Shoggoth Flesh, an Abyssal Wasteland Essence, a Dreadlands Essence and an Omothol Essence.
abyssalcraft_02.ac.ritual.hdurationCharm.desc: A Duration Hastur Charm is made by infusion a Hastur Charm with Redstone Dust and Shadow Fragments.
abyssalcraft_02.ac.ritual.hpowerCharm.desc: A Power Hastur Charm is made by infusion a Hastur Charm with Glowstone Dust and Shadow Fragments.
abyssalcraft_02.ac.ritual.hrangeCharm.desc: A Range Hastur Charm is made by infusion a Hastur Charm with Arrows and Shadow Fragments.
abyssalcraft_02.ac.ritual.interdimensionalcage.desc: An Interdimensional Cage is created by infusing a Shard of Oblivion with Iron Bars. It can use Potential Energy to capture Entities. The amount of PE required is determined by the Entity's metric volume (ratio: 100 PE/m³), so larger entities require more PE to capture. PE is only drained when you capture an Entity.
abyssalcraft_02.ac.ritual.jdurationCharm.desc: A Duration J'zahar Charm is made by infusion a J'zahar Charm with Redstone Dust and Shadow Fragments.
abyssalcraft_02.ac.ritual.jpowerCharm.desc: A Power J'zahar Charm is made by infusion a J'zahar Charm with Glowstone Dust and Shadow Fragments.
abyssalcraft_02.ac.ritual.jrangeCharm.desc: A Range J'zahar Charm is made by infusion a J'zahar Charm with Arrows and Shadow Fragments.
abyssalcraft_02.ac.ritual.jzaharCharm.desc: A J'zahar Charm is made by infusing a Ritual Charm with J'zahar Engraved Coins.
abyssalcraft_02.ac.ritual.jzaharStaff.desc: A Staff of The Gatekeeper is created by infusing a Staff of Rending with an Abyssal Wasteland Essence, a Dreadlands Essence, an Omothol Essence, Eldritch Scales and Ethaxium Ingots.
abyssalcraft_02.ac.ritual.jzaharStatue.desc: A J'zahar Statue is created by infusing a Monolith Stone with Eldritch Scales, an Abyssal Wasteland Essence, a Dreadlands Essence and an Omothol Essence.
abyssalcraft_02.ac.ritual.lesserScroll.desc: A Lesser Scroll is created with 2 Books, a Wasteland's Thorn and a Luminous Thistle
abyssalcraft_02.ac.ritual.massEnchantment.desc: By presesenting 8 Enchanted Books and an Item on the altar, all of the Enchantments will be combined and applied on the Item. You can use any combination of Enchantments, and all levels will be combined, so multiple instances of the same Enchantment can surpass the normal boundaries.
abyssalcraft_02.ac.ritual.moderateScroll.desc: A Moderate Scroll is created with 2 Books, a Dread Fragment and a Dreaded Shard of Abyssalnite
abyssalcraft_02.ac.ritual.ndurationCharm.desc: A Duration Nyarlathotep Charm is made by infusion a Nyarlathotep Charm with Redstone Dust and Shadow Fragments.
abyssalcraft_02.ac.ritual.npowerCharm.desc: A Power Nyarlathotep Charm is made by infusion a Nyarlathotep Charm with Glowstone Dust and Shadow Fragments.
abyssalcraft_02.ac.ritual.nrangeCharm.desc: A Range Nyarlathotep Charm is made by infusion a Nyarlathotep Charm with Arrows and Shadow Fragments.
abyssalcraft_02.ac.ritual.nyarlathotepCharm.desc: A Nyarlathotep Charm is made by infusing a Ritual Charm with Nyarlathotep Engraved Coins.
abyssalcraft_02.ac.ritual.nyarlathotepStatue.desc: A Nyarlathotep Statue is created by infusing a Monolith Stone with Dreaded Shoggoth Flesh, an Abyssal Wasteland Essence, a Dreadlands Essence and an Omothol Essence.
abyssalcraft_02.ac.ritual.oblivionCatalyst.desc: An Oblivion Catalyst is created by infusing an Eye of Ender with Shards of Oblivion and Redstone Dust.
abyssalcraft_02.ac.ritual.powerCharm.desc: A Power Ritual Charm is made by infusion a Ritual Charm with Glowstone Dust and Shadow Fragments.
abyssalcraft_02.ac.ritual.powerStone.desc: A Dreadlands Infused Powerstone is created by infusing Coralium Infused Stone with Dreadlands Essences.
abyssalcraft_02.ac.ritual.purging.desc: By presenting 4 Crystallized Calcium Clusters and a large amount of energy, you purge every trace of the Dread Plague (and the Dreadlands) from the area, putting a stop to it here (also kills nearby mobs). While it renders the area uninhabitable, no plagues will be able to spread here. Doesn't work in the Dreadlands.
abyssalcraft_02.ac.ritual.rangeCharm.desc: A Range Ritual Charm is made by infusion a Ritual Charm with Arrows and Shadow Fragments.

aether_legacy_01.lore.aether_legacy.aechor_petal: The petal of an Aechor Plant, they have a sweet aroma to them. These are a Moa's favorite food, and can be used to feed baby Moas.
aether_legacy_01.lore.aether_legacy.aerogel: The result of the Aether's unique climate and lava combining. It can be crafted into various decorative blocks and is blast resistant.
aether_legacy_01.lore.aether_legacy.aerogel_slab: Crafted from Aerogel. Slabs are half blocks, versatile for decoration and smooth slopes. Try adding some to a building’s roofing!
aether_legacy_01.lore.aether_legacy.aerogel_stairs: Crafted from Aerogel. Stairs are useful for adding verticality to builds and are often used for decoration too!
aether_legacy_01.lore.aether_legacy.aerogel_wall: Crafted from Aerogel. Can be used for decorative enclosures and defences. Great for keeping nasty intruders away!
aether_legacy_01.lore.aether_legacy.aether_dirt: A pale dirt. It can be found in the Aether, and can also be used to grow the native trees. It can grow into grass with enough light.
aether_legacy_01.lore.aether_legacy.aether_grass: Grass found in the Aether dimension. It can be used to grow the trees native to the Aether. It is much more pale than normal Grass.
aether_legacy_01.lore.aether_legacy.aether_portal: I'm sad you had to cheat that in to check what it does. ~Kino
aether_legacy_01.lore.aether_legacy.aether_tune: A music disc that plays Aether Tune by Noisestorm.
aether_legacy_01.lore.aether_legacy.agility_cape: A slightly rare cape, it can be seen in Bronze and Silver Dungeons. It makes the wearer's legs stronger, therefore they can walk up blocks instantly.
aether_legacy_01.lore.aether_legacy.ambrosium_ore: The most common ore in the Aether. The drops can be doubled with Skyroot tools.
aether_legacy_01.lore.aether_legacy.ambrosium_shard: Aether's coal equivalent, they have a healing property when eaten, and restore a small amount of health.
aether_legacy_01.lore.aether_legacy.ambrosium_torch: The main light source for the Aether, made with a Skyroot Stick and Ambrosium.
aether_legacy_01.lore.aether_legacy.angelic_slab: Crafted from Angelic Stone. Slabs are half blocks, versatile for decoration and smooth slopes. Try adding some to a building’s roofing!
aether_legacy_01.lore.aether_legacy.angelic_stairs: Crafted from Angelic Stone. Stairs are useful for adding verticality to builds and are often used for decoration too!
aether_legacy_01.lore.aether_legacy.angelic_stone: Angelic Stone is the main block that makes up Silver Dungeons. There is a chance some of them can be traps when generated in dungeons, but you cannot collect them as traps. It is unbreakable until you have defeated the boss, but it's worth it for that block.
aether_legacy_01.lore.aether_legacy.angelic_wall: Crafted from Angelic Stone. Can be used for decorative enclosures and defences. Great for keeping nasty intruders away!
aether_legacy_01.lore.aether_legacy.ascending_dawn: A music disc that plays Ascending Dawn by Emile van Krieken.
aether_legacy_01.lore.aether_legacy.berry_bush: These bushes can be found all over the Aether. They provide Blue Berries when broken, and then turn into bare stems. If placed on Enchanted Aether Grass the drops are doubled.
aether_legacy_01.lore.aether_legacy.berry_bush_stem: This is the result of harvesting the Blue Berries from a Berry Bush. It can take some time for them to grow back.
aether_legacy_01.lore.aether_legacy.black_moa_egg: An Egg laid by a Black Moa. Hatching this provides a Black Moa with 8 mid-air jumps, the best and most rare one!
aether_legacy_01.lore.aether_legacy.blue_aercloud: A pale blue cloud found close to the ground. It has very bouncy properties, and can help you reach high places.

aether_legacy_02.lore.aether_legacy.blue_berry: Harvested from Berry Bushes, this is the most common food source in the Aether. It has very weak hunger restoration. You can enchant these in an Altar for much better hunger restoration.
aether_legacy_02.lore.aether_legacy.blue_cape: A Blue Cape that has a silky feeling to it. It's crafted using Blue Wool.
aether_legacy_02.lore.aether_legacy.blue_moa_egg: An Egg laid by a Blue Moa. Hatching this provides a Blue Moa with 3 mid-air jumps. The most common Moa.
aether_legacy_02.lore.aether_legacy.candy_cane: Found in presents under Holiday trees! They can be used to repair Candy Cane swords, and are a very tasty treat.
aether_legacy_02.lore.aether_legacy.candy_cane_sword: A sword made from decorative candy. Randomly drops Candy Canes when used. These are dropped from presents that are under Holiday Trees.
aether_legacy_02.lore.aether_legacy.carved_slab: Crafted from Carved Stone. Slabs are half blocks, versatile for decoration and smooth slopes. Try adding some to a building’s roofing!
aether_legacy_02.lore.aether_legacy.carved_stairs: Crafted from Sentry Stone. Stairs are useful for adding verticality to builds and are often used for decoration too!
aether_legacy_02.lore.aether_legacy.carved_stone: The Stone found in Bronze Dungeons. This stone has a gray color to it, and can be mined as a decorative block.
aether_legacy_02.lore.aether_legacy.carved_wall: Crafted from Carved Stone. Can be used for decorative enclosures and defences. Great for keeping nasty intruders away!
aether_legacy_02.lore.aether_legacy.chain_gloves: A very rare part of chain armor, it is needed to complete the Chain Armor set.
aether_legacy_02.lore.aether_legacy.chest_mimic: It may look like a normal chest, but it really isn't. As soon as you right click on it, a chest mimic will pop out! These appear in Bronze and Silver dungeons.
aether_legacy_02.lore.aether_legacy.cloud_staff: A staff with a light and fluffy top. It summons small Cloud Sentries to fight next to the user for a short period of time by shooting large Iceballs.
aether_legacy_02.lore.aether_legacy.cold_aercloud: A cold cloud found in the skies of the Aether. It can be used to make Parachutes, and break drops that would otherwise be very dangerous.
aether_legacy_02.lore.aether_legacy.cold_parachute: A quickly made parachute. It's fluffy to the touch and is made from Cold Aerclouds. It has one use.
aether_legacy_02.lore.aether_legacy.crystal_fruit_leaves: Crystal Leaves that are home to White Apples.
aether_legacy_02.lore.aether_legacy.crystal_leaves: Leaves that come from Crystal Trees, they generate on floating islands. Sometimes they have fruit on them, which can cure poison.
aether_legacy_02.lore.aether_legacy.dart_enchanted: The ammo for Enchanted Dart Shooters. This is the strongest of the darts, made by enchanting Golden Darts.
aether_legacy_02.lore.aether_legacy.dart_golden: The ammo for Golden Dart Shooters. Crafted with Skyroot Sticks and Golden Amber, enchanting these converts them to Enchanted Darts.
aether_legacy_02.lore.aether_legacy.dart_poison: The ammo for Poison Dart Shooters, these are made by infecting Golden Darts with poison!
aether_legacy_02.lore.aether_legacy.dart_shooter_enchante: A Dart Shooter which shoots Enchanted Darts, the strongest one!
aether_legacy_02.lore.aether_legacy.dart_shooter_golden: A Dart Shooter which shoots Golden Darts, enchanting it on an Altar improves it's attack power!
aether_legacy_02.lore.aether_legacy.dart_shooter_poison: A Dart Shooter which shoots Poison Darts. Shooting this at something infects them with a deadly poison!
aether_legacy_02.lore.aether_legacy.decorated_holiday_lea: Holiday Leaves that have been decorated with lovely little baubles for extra holiday cheer!
aether_legacy_02.lore.aether_legacy.diamond_gloves: Part of the Diamond Armor set, it is needed to complete the Diamond Armor set.
aether_legacy_02.lore.aether_legacy.dungeon_key_bronze: A dull key that is dropped from the Slider after being defeated. You can use it to claim the treasure you earned!
aether_legacy_02.lore.aether_legacy.dungeon_key_golden: A key that has a shiny finish. It is dropped by the Sun Spirit after you defeat him. You can use it to claim the legendary treasure in the back room!
aether_legacy_02.lore.aether_legacy.dungeon_key_platinum: Only the true holder knows what unlocks with this key.
aether_legacy_02.lore.aether_legacy.dungeon_key_silver: A reflective key that is given to you by the Valkyrie Queen after defeating her. Use it to claim the treasure she left behind!
aether_legacy_02.lore.aether_legacy.enchanted_aether_gras: Aether Grass enchanted which allows for increasing harvest rates of Blue Berries.
aether_legacy_02.lore.aether_legacy.enchanted_blueberry: An excellent food source, it tastes quite good and restores a massive amount of hunger.
aether_legacy_02.lore.aether_legacy.enchanted_gravitite: After putting Gravitite Ore into an Altar and enchanting it, you get Enchanted Gravitite. This can be made into Gravitite Tools and Armor. When powered with a Redstone signal, Enchanted Gravitite Blocks will float into the air, similarly to Gravitite Ore.
aether_legacy_02.lore.aether_legacy.enchanter: Used to enchant items and repair armor. They are powered by Ambrosium Shards. The enchanting process can take some time, but if you place an Enchanted Gravitite block under it, the process is sped up by a huge amount.
aether_legacy_02.lore.aether_legacy.flaming_sword: An ancient sword which flames its foes to a burning crisp. It almost hurts to touch! Using this on animals can make them drop cooked meat!
aether_legacy_02.lore.aether_legacy.freezer: You can freeze various items using this, such as Aerclouds, or Water Buckets. It's source of power is Icestone. You can speed up the freezing process by placing an Icestone under the Freezer.
aether_legacy_02.lore.aether_legacy.ginger_bread_man: Found in presents under Holiday trees, these are the most common of Christmas items. They are very abundant when dropped from presents.
aether_legacy_02.lore.aether_legacy.golden_aercloud: A golden cloud found in small quantities, higher in the air than normal. The properties are similar to Cold Aerclouds, but the Parachutes they produce have much more durability.
aether_legacy_02.lore.aether_legacy.golden_amber: These round golden orbs can be obtained by mining Golden Oak Logs with a Gravitite Axe. Their main purpose is to craft Golden Darts, and Dart Shooters.
aether_legacy_02.lore.aether_legacy.golden_feather: A fluffy feather found in Silver Dungeons. When worn, the wearer becomes lighter than air and can descend slowly.
aether_legacy_02.lore.aether_legacy.golden_gloves: Part of the Golden Armor set, it is needed to complete the Gold Armor set.
aether_legacy_02.lore.aether_legacy.golden_oak_leaves: These golden Leaves generate with Golden Oak trees. They spawn golden particles in a radius of 5 blocks. They yield Golden Oak Saplings when decayed.
aether_legacy_02.lore.aether_legacy.golden_oak_log: Skyroot Log which contains Golden Amber inside. When broken with an Axe they drop Skyroot Logs, and if the Axe is Gravitite, they will drop Golden Amber.
aether_legacy_02.lore.aether_legacy.golden_oak_sapling: These large saplings when planted will grow into huge Golden Oak trees! You can use Bone Meal to speed up the process.
aether_legacy_02.lore.aether_legacy.golden_parachute: The best parachute in the Aether. It has 20 uses and is made with Golden Aerclouds.
aether_legacy_02.lore.aether_legacy.golden_pendant: An aesthetic accessory made of gold.
aether_legacy_02.lore.aether_legacy.golden_ring: An aesthetic accessory made of gold.
aether_legacy_02.lore.aether_legacy.gravitite_axe: Part of Aether's best tool tier, this Axe not only can make wood blocks float, but it can mine Golden Oak logs for Golden Amber!
aether_legacy_02.lore.aether_legacy.gravitite_boots: Part of Aether's best armor set, when the full set is worn, you get an extra high jump!
aether_legacy_02.lore.aether_legacy.gravitite_chestplate: Part of Aether's best armor set, when the full set is worn, you get an extra high jump!
aether_legacy_02.lore.aether_legacy.gravitite_gloves: Part of Aether's best armor set, needed to complete the Gravitite set.
aether_legacy_02.lore.aether_legacy.gravitite_helmet: Part of Aether's best armor set, when the full set is worn, you get an extra high jump!
aether_legacy_02.lore.aether_legacy.gravitite_leggings: Part of Aether's best armor set, when the full set is worn, you get an extra high jump!
aether_legacy_02.lore.aether_legacy.gravitite_ore: This is Aether's rarest ore. It has floating properties and will float upward when there is nothing above it. These can be Enchanted into Enchanted Gravitite Blocks.
aether_legacy_02.lore.aether_legacy.gravitite_pickaxe: Part of Aether's best tool tier, when mining with this powerful tool, you can right-click on any stone block and it will levitate into the air! You can mine any ore with this Pickaxe.
aether_legacy_02.lore.aether_legacy.gravitite_shovel: Part of Aether's best tool tier, this shovel has the special ability to make dirt blocks, or sand levitate! When combined with enchantments such as Efficiency, it will instantly break Aether Dirt!
aether_legacy_02.lore.aether_legacy.gravitite_sword: Part of Aether's best tool tier, when attacking with this powerful weapon, anything you hit will be flung into the air, causing lots of damage! Use this to your advantage, as it works even while your sword is cooling down!
aether_legacy_02.lore.aether_legacy.green_leaves: These leaves generate with Skyroot Trees. They can drop Skyroot Saplings when decaying.
aether_legacy_02.lore.aether_legacy.gummy_swet_blue: A sweet smelling gummy, it can be found in random chests in Bronze and Silver dungeons. It restores the player’s hunger to full. Very useful for boss fights.

aether_legacy_03.lore.aether_legacy.gummy_swet_golden: A sour tasting gummy, it can be found in random chests in Bronze and Silver dungeons. It restores the player’s hunger to full. Very useful for boss fights.
aether_legacy_03.lore.aether_legacy.healing_stone: Obtained from enchanting Holystone, it can be used as a reliable healing source, providing Regeneration. It has a surprisingly juicy flavor.
aether_legacy_03.lore.aether_legacy.hellfire_slab: Crafted from Hellfire Stone. Slabs are half blocks, versatile for decoration and smooth slopes. Try adding some to a building’s roofing!
aether_legacy_03.lore.aether_legacy.hellfire_stairs: Crafted from Hellfire Stone. Stairs are useful for adding verticality to builds and are often used for decoration too!
aether_legacy_03.lore.aether_legacy.hellfire_stone: A warm, red stone that makes up 90%% of Gold Dungeon interior. It cannot be destroyed until the Sun Spirit is defeated.
aether_legacy_03.lore.aether_legacy.hellfire_wall: Crafted from Hellfire Stone. Can be used for decorative enclosures and defences. Great for keeping nasty intruders away!
aether_legacy_03.lore.aether_legacy.holiday_leaves: Leaves on Christmas trees! It snows near them, and there is always presents nearby!
aether_legacy_03.lore.aether_legacy.holy_sword: An ancient sword which does heavy amounts of damage to undead foes. A perfect weapon for traversing the Overworld.
aether_legacy_03.lore.aether_legacy.holystone: The Aether's native rock. It can be used in various ways such as creating tools, construction, as well being able to be crafted into Holystone Bricks.
aether_legacy_03.lore.aether_legacy.holystone_axe: One of Aether's stone tools, it mines faster than Skyroot Tools, as well as dropping random Ambrosium Shards.
aether_legacy_03.lore.aether_legacy.holystone_brick: Used as a building material native to the Aether. It is made from Holystone and is more sturdy than it too.
aether_legacy_03.lore.aether_legacy.holystone_brick_slab: Crafted from Holystone Bricks. Slabs are half blocks, versatile for decoration and smooth slopes. Try adding some to a building’s roofing!
aether_legacy_03.lore.aether_legacy.holystone_brick_stair: Crafted from Holystone Bricks. Stairs are useful for adding verticality to builds and are often used for decoration too!
aether_legacy_03.lore.aether_legacy.holystone_brick_wall: Crafted from Holystone Bricks. Can be used for decorative enclosures and defences. Great for keeping nasty intruders away!
aether_legacy_03.lore.aether_legacy.holystone_pickaxe: One of Aether's stone tools, it can mine Zanite, and will randomly drop Ambrosium Shards while mining.
aether_legacy_03.lore.aether_legacy.holystone_shovel: One of Aether's stone tools, it can mine Quicksoil, and all other blocks a Stone Shovel can mine, except it drops random Ambrosium Shards.
aether_legacy_03.lore.aether_legacy.holystone_slab: Crafted from Holystone. Slabs are half blocks, versatile for decoration and smooth slopes. Try adding some to a building’s roofing!
aether_legacy_03.lore.aether_legacy.holystone_stairs: Crafted from Holystone. Stairs are useful for adding verticality to builds and are often used for decoration too!
aether_legacy_03.lore.aether_legacy.holystone_sword: One of Aether's stone tools, it can drop Ambrosium Shards at random while attacking.
aether_legacy_03.lore.aether_legacy.holystone_wall: Crafted from Holystone. Can be used for decorative enclosures and defences. Great for keeping nasty intruders away!
aether_legacy_03.lore.aether_legacy.ice_pendant: A pendant which allows you to freeze water, and lava when walked on.
aether_legacy_03.lore.aether_legacy.ice_ring: A ring which allows you to freeze water, and lava when walked on.
aether_legacy_03.lore.aether_legacy.icestone: Icestone is a common ore that can be used as fuel for a Freezer. It can be used to freeze nearby liquids such as Lava and Water.
aether_legacy_03.lore.aether_legacy.incubator: Used to incubate Moa's. You use Ambrosium Torches for the fuel. The process can take quite some time, but it is worth the wait once your Moa of choice hatches!
aether_legacy_03.lore.aether_legacy.invisibility_cape: A cloak that makes the wearer completely invisible! Since mobs cannot see you, they cannot attack you. Sneak up on your enemies with it!
aether_legacy_03.lore.aether_legacy.iron_bubble: A common dungeon loot. It allows for the wearer to breathe underwater for a longer time than normal.
aether_legacy_03.lore.aether_legacy.iron_gloves: Part of the Iron Armor set, it is needed to complete the Iron Armor set.
aether_legacy_03.lore.aether_legacy.iron_pendant: An aesthetic accessory made of iron.
aether_legacy_03.lore.aether_legacy.iron_ring: An aesthetic accessory made of iron.
aether_legacy_03.lore.aether_legacy.jeb_hammer: A mysterious hammer that shoots projectiles out of it. At one point it vanished from existence. It's said this was actually Jeb's hammer at one point.
aether_legacy_03.lore.aether_legacy.leather_gloves: Dyeable gloves to match your leather tunic! This is needed to complete the Leather armor set.
aether_legacy_03.lore.aether_legacy.legacy: A music disc that plays Legacy by xJonL.
aether_legacy_03.lore.aether_legacy.life_shard: A very rare item found in Gold Dungeons. Using this will give you an extra permanent heart! The feeling of using it is very strange, and hard to describe.
aether_legacy_03.lore.aether_legacy.light_angelic_stone: The Light version of Angelic Stone. It is less common than Angelic Stone, but it looks really nice as a decorative block.
aether_legacy_03.lore.aether_legacy.light_hellfire_stone: The Light version of Hellfire Stone. It can be found in Gold Dungeons along with Hellfire stone, but like it's counterpart, it cannot be collected until the boss is defeated.
aether_legacy_03.lore.aether_legacy.lightning_knife: Small knives that when thrown, summon lightning bolts where they land.
aether_legacy_03.lore.aether_legacy.lightning_sword: An ancient sword which summons lightning to its foes.
aether_legacy_03.lore.aether_legacy.lore_book: A large book containing many lore entries written by the wise Lorist. It describes every object in detail.
aether_legacy_03.lore.aether_legacy.mossy_holystone: A more aged Holystone, it is found near dungeons, and has pale colored vines growing on it, very decorative.
aether_legacy_03.lore.aether_legacy.mossy_holystone_slab: Crafted from Mossy Holystone. Slabs are half blocks, versatile for decoration and smooth slopes. Try adding some to a building’s roofing!
aether_legacy_03.lore.aether_legacy.mossy_holystone_stair: Crafted from Mossy Holystone. Stairs are useful for adding verticality to builds and are often used for decoration too!
aether_legacy_03.lore.aether_legacy.mossy_holystone_wall: Crafted from Mossy Holystone. Can be used for decorative enclosures and defences. Great for keeping nasty intruders away!
aether_legacy_03.lore.aether_legacy.nature_staff: A staff that can allow for commanding tamed Moas. It can allow them to sit on the ground.
aether_legacy_03.lore.aether_legacy.neptune_boots: Found in Silver Dungeons, this armor allows for water walking. The full set is a much better replacement for the Depth Strider enchantment.
aether_legacy_03.lore.aether_legacy.neptune_chestplate: Found in Silver Dungeons, this armor allows for water walking. Combined with an Iron Bubble, this armor set is super useful for defeating underwater temples.
aether_legacy_03.lore.aether_legacy.neptune_gloves: Found in Silver Dungeons, these gloves are requires to complete the Neptune Armor set, which allows for underwater walking.
aether_legacy_03.lore.aether_legacy.neptune_helmet: Found in Silver Dungeons, this armor allows for water walking. Combined with an Iron Bubble, this armor set is super useful for defeating underwater temples.
aether_legacy_03.lore.aether_legacy.neptune_leggings: Found in Silver Dungeons, this armor allows for water walking. Combined with an Iron Bubble, this armor set is super useful for defeating underwater temples.
aether_legacy_03.lore.aether_legacy.notch_hammer: A mighty hammer which shoots heavy projectiles at mobs. It's said that Notch actually held this hammer.
aether_legacy_03.lore.aether_legacy.obsidian_boots: A super powerful armor, more powerful than Diamond, this armor is only obtainable by standing in water while wearing Phoenix Armor, converting it to Obsidian.
aether_legacy_03.lore.aether_legacy.obsidian_chestplate: A super powerful armor, more powerful than Diamond, this armor is only obtainable by standing in water while wearing Phoenix Armor, converting it to Obsidian.
aether_legacy_03.lore.aether_legacy.obsidian_gloves: Needed to complete the Obsidian Armor set, you can convert Phoenix Gloves into Obsidian by standing in water while wearing them.
aether_legacy_03.lore.aether_legacy.obsidian_helmet: A super powerful armor, more powerful than Diamond, this armor is only obtainable by standing in water while wearing Phoenix Armor, converting it to Obsidian.
aether_legacy_03.lore.aether_legacy.obsidian_leggings: A super powerful armor, more powerful than Diamond, this armor is only obtainable by standing in water while wearing Phoenix Armor, converting it to Obsidian.
aether_legacy_03.lore.aether_legacy.orange_moa_egg: An Egg laid by an Orange Moa. Hatching this provides an Orange Moa with 2 mid-air jumps, but extreme speed. This Moa is quite common.
aether_legacy_03.lore.aether_legacy.phoenix_boots: Found in Gold Dungeons, when fully worn, this armor set allows for Fire Resistance, you can swim in Lava as well. Be careful when standing in water, as it will turn into Obsidian armor.
aether_legacy_03.lore.aether_legacy.phoenix_bow: Found as a dungeon loot, this bow is very heated, and can shoot flaming arrows! It's warm to the touch.
aether_legacy_03.lore.aether_legacy.phoenix_chestplate: Found in Gold Dungeons, when fully worn, this armor set allows for Fire Resistance, you can swim in Lava as well. Be careful when standing in water, as it will turn into Obsidian armor.

aether_legacy_04.lore.aether_legacy.phoenix_gloves: Found in Gold Dungeons, these gloves are required to finish the Phoenix Armor set, and are needed to convert the full set into Obsidian too.
aether_legacy_04.lore.aether_legacy.phoenix_helmet: Found in Gold Dungeons, when fully worn, this armor set allows for Fire Resistance, you can swim in Lava as well. Be careful when standing in water, as it will turn into Obsidian armor.
aether_legacy_04.lore.aether_legacy.phoenix_leggings: Found in Gold Dungeons, when fully worn, this armor set allows for Fire Resistance, you can swim in Lava as well. Be careful when standing in water, as it will turn into Obsidian armor.
aether_legacy_04.lore.aether_legacy.pig_slayer: Kills any Pig type mobs with nothing with a single blow. But why would you want to do that? Great for traversing the Nether.
aether_legacy_04.lore.aether_legacy.pillar: The main part of the Silver Dungeon's decorative pillars, they spawn all around the dungeon, and are excellent for building.
aether_legacy_04.lore.aether_legacy.pillar_top: The top of the Silver Dungeon's decorative pillars, they look excellent, and are great for building.
aether_legacy_04.lore.aether_legacy.pink_aercloud: A very soft cloud that is pink. It has natural healing properties, healing anyone's wounds when stepped in.
aether_legacy_04.lore.aether_legacy.present: A wonderful holiday gift, open it for a surprise! Be careful, as there's a chance you could get ssssssurprised!
aether_legacy_04.lore.aether_legacy.purple_flower: These pretty violet flowers can be found in large numbers around the Aether. They can be crafted into purple dye when placed into a Crafting Table.
aether_legacy_04.lore.aether_legacy.quicksoil: A silky sand with extremely slippery properties. It can be seen floating on the side of Aether islands. Be careful around it, or you'll fall off.
aether_legacy_04.lore.aether_legacy.quicksoil_glass: After enchanting Quicksoil you can get this tinted glass. It is slightly slippery and makes a for a great window.
aether_legacy_04.lore.aether_legacy.red_cape: A rough feeling cape that is crafted using Red Wool.
aether_legacy_04.lore.aether_legacy.regeneration_stone: A treasure found in Silver Dungeons. This stone makes the wearer feel healthy, and heals their wounds. The effects can stack with other Regeneration Stones.
aether_legacy_04.lore.aether_legacy.repulsion_shield: A shield that protects the user from most projectiles. It will reflect the projectile back at the thrower and cause damage to them. Each time a projectile is reflected the shield will be damaged.
aether_legacy_04.lore.aether_legacy.sentry_boots: Found in Bronze Dungeons, these boots protect you from fall damage, allowing you to fall from great heights.
aether_legacy_04.lore.aether_legacy.sentry_stone: The Light version of Carved Stone, also found in Bronze Dungeons.
aether_legacy_04.lore.aether_legacy.skyroot_axe: One of Aether's wooden tools, it can be used to double Skyroot Log drops. Simple but useful for beginners.
aether_legacy_04.lore.aether_legacy.skyroot_bed_item: Crafted with cyan wool and skyroot planks. You can only sleep at night to skip night time, but during the day you can set your respawn point in the Aether. Cannot sleep while mobs are nearby.
aether_legacy_04.lore.aether_legacy.skyroot_bookshelf: Crafted from Skyroot Planks and Books. Bookshelves can be used to enhance the enchanting capabilities of an enchanting table.
aether_legacy_04.lore.aether_legacy.skyroot_bucket_empty: A hand crafted bucket, used to contain Aechor poison, a nice Remedy or even just plain Water!
aether_legacy_04.lore.aether_legacy.skyroot_bucket_milk: A bucket full of fresh Milk, drink it to heal potion effects.
aether_legacy_04.lore.aether_legacy.skyroot_bucket_poison: A Skyroot Bucket that has been filled with a deadly poison. Better not drink it! It can be used to craft Poison Darts and Dart Shooters. Enchant it to cure the poison in it.
aether_legacy_04.lore.aether_legacy.skyroot_bucket_remedy: A Skyroot Bucket containing a soothing remedy. It has a strong smell. Drinking this cures deadly poison, and prevents it for a short time.
aether_legacy_04.lore.aether_legacy.skyroot_bucket_water: A Skyroot Bucket that is filled to the brim with Water.
aether_legacy_04.lore.aether_legacy.skyroot_fence: Crafted from Skyroot planks and Sticks. Great for keeping your livestock safe from wandering predators!
aether_legacy_04.lore.aether_legacy.skyroot_fence_gate: Crafted from Sticks and Skyroot planks. Gives a homely entrance and exit to your precious enclosures.
aether_legacy_04.lore.aether_legacy.skyroot_log: These spawn with Skyroot Trees. They can be double dropped with Skyroot Axes. When put in a crafting table they will provide 4 Skyroot Planks.
aether_legacy_04.lore.aether_legacy.skyroot_pickaxe: One of Aether's wooden tools, when mining Holystone or Ambrosium ore, it will double the drops. This is even better when combined with an enchantment such as Fortune when mining Ambrosium Shards!
aether_legacy_04.lore.aether_legacy.skyroot_plank: Skyroot Planks can be made into various tools, blocks and items. They are crafted from Skyroot Logs, and make a great building material.
aether_legacy_04.lore.aether_legacy.skyroot_sapling: These small green saplings will grow into Skyroot Trees. They can be grown faster with Bone Meal.
aether_legacy_04.lore.aether_legacy.skyroot_shovel: One of Aether's wooden tools, it doubles Aether dirt and Quicksoil drops.
aether_legacy_04.lore.aether_legacy.skyroot_slab: Crafted from Skyroot. Slabs are half blocks, versatile for decoration and smooth slopes. Try adding some to a building’s roofing!
aether_legacy_04.lore.aether_legacy.skyroot_stairs: Crafted from Skyroot Planks. Stairs are useful for adding verticality to builds and are often used for decoration too!
aether_legacy_04.lore.aether_legacy.skyroot_stick: Crafted from Skyroot Planks. Used to create various aether tools and items. Nothing else too special about it.
aether_legacy_04.lore.aether_legacy.skyroot_sword: One of Aether's wooden tools, it has a low amount of durability, and doubles mob drops. It makes an excellent food collected when combined with enchantments such as Looting and Fire Aspect.
aether_legacy_04.lore.aether_legacy.sun_altar: An Altar containing the power to control the Sun itself! It is dropped by the Sun Spirit after you defeat him. Use it to control the time of day.
aether_legacy_04.lore.aether_legacy.swet_cape: A common cape that is found in Bronze Dungeons. It allows for the wearer to ride Swets, as they become friendly when they see someone wearing it.
aether_legacy_04.lore.aether_legacy.swetty_ball: A gooey orb that is dropped from Blue Swets. It can be used to fertilize soils. Another use is to put it alongside string to make a lead.
aether_legacy_04.lore.aether_legacy.treasure_chest: A treasure chest, these are found after defeating a Bronze, Silver or Gold dungeon. Any of the keys can open these, and the specific dungeon's loot will pop out.
aether_legacy_04.lore.aether_legacy.valkyrie_axe: A tool unique to the Silver Dungeon, This Axe has a very far reach, and very high attack power, you can use this to your advantage, but be warned, the attack cooldown is very high on this.
aether_legacy_04.lore.aether_legacy.valkyrie_boots: An armor unique to the Silver Dungeon, when fully worn, you are granted temporary flight. Quite useful for getting to high places.
aether_legacy_04.lore.aether_legacy.valkyrie_cape: A rare cape that is found in Silver Dungeons. When worn, the wearer becomes lighter than air and can descend slowly.
aether_legacy_04.lore.aether_legacy.valkyrie_chestplate: An armor unique to the Silver Dungeon, when fully worn, you are granted temporary flight. Quite useful for getting to high places.
aether_legacy_04.lore.aether_legacy.valkyrie_gloves: An armor unique to the Silver Dungeon. The gloves are needed to complete the armor set, which grants temporary flight.
aether_legacy_04.lore.aether_legacy.valkyrie_helmet: An armor unique to the Silver Dungeon, when fully worn, you are granted temporary flight. Quite useful for getting to high places.
aether_legacy_04.lore.aether_legacy.valkyrie_lance: A tool unique to the Silver Dungeon, this long range weapon is very good for defeating Zephyrs, and Valkyrie Queens.
aether_legacy_04.lore.aether_legacy.valkyrie_leggings: An armor unique to the Silver Dungeon, when fully worn, you are granted temporary flight. Quite useful for getting to high places.
aether_legacy_04.lore.aether_legacy.valkyrie_pickaxe: A tool unique to the Silver Dungeon, this pickaxe is very useful when it comes to mining blocks from under islands, as it has a very far reach, almost double the normal reach! It is also quite useful for fighting the Slider.
aether_legacy_04.lore.aether_legacy.valkyrie_shovel: A tool unique to the Silver Dungeon, this shovel can help you reach Quicksoil from a safer distance, quite useful wouldn't you say?
aether_legacy_04.lore.aether_legacy.vampire_blade: A mysterious sword that has life-stealing abilities. Holding it just makes you feel creepily empty...
aether_legacy_04.lore.aether_legacy.victory_medal: Proof of defeating a lesser Valkyrie. Use these to prove to the Queen you are worthy enough to fight her!
aether_legacy_04.lore.aether_legacy.welcoming_skies: A music disc that plays Welcoming Skies by Voyed.
aether_legacy_04.lore.aether_legacy.white_apple: One of the only known cures for the Aether's deadly poison. You can find them on Crystal Trees.
aether_legacy_04.lore.aether_legacy.white_cape: A light and fluffy cape that is made from White Wool.
aether_legacy_04.lore.aether_legacy.white_flower: These extremely good smelling roses can make great gifts to a friend or loved one. They spawn in large groups around the Aether.
aether_legacy_04.lore.aether_legacy.white_moa_egg: An Egg laid by a White Moa. Hatching this provides a White Moa with 4 mid-air jumps. This Moa is decently rare.

aether_legacy_05.lore.aether_legacy.yellow_cape: A bright Yellow Cape that is crafted using Yellow Wool.
aether_legacy_05.lore.aether_legacy.zanite_axe: One of Aether's mid-tier tools, you can mine wood faster than stone, and it will get even faster as the tool is worn down.
aether_legacy_05.lore.aether_legacy.zanite_block: A block of compacted Zanite Gemstones. They can power beacons, and just have a sleek look to them.
aether_legacy_05.lore.aether_legacy.zanite_boots: Part of the Zanite Armor set, the protection it grants increases as the durability decreases.
aether_legacy_05.lore.aether_legacy.zanite_chestplate: Part of the Zanite Armor set, the protection it grants increases as the durability decreases.
aether_legacy_05.lore.aether_legacy.zanite_gemstone: Aether's version of Iron. These shiny purple gems can be made into tools and armor, that increase in strength when used.
aether_legacy_05.lore.aether_legacy.zanite_gloves: Part of the Zanite Armor set, it is needed to complete the Zanite Armor set.
aether_legacy_05.lore.aether_legacy.zanite_helmet: Part of the Zanite Armor set, the protection it grants increases as the durability decreases.
aether_legacy_05.lore.aether_legacy.zanite_leggings: Part of the Zanite Armor set, the protection it grants increases as the durability decreases.
aether_legacy_05.lore.aether_legacy.zanite_ore: A slightly rare ore that drops Zanite Gemstones when broken with Stone tools.
aether_legacy_05.lore.aether_legacy.zanite_pendant: A pendant which allows you to mine faster. It doesn't last for long, so use it wisely!
aether_legacy_05.lore.aether_legacy.zanite_pickaxe: One of Aether's mid-tier tools, it mines what Iron can, except as it's durability decreases, it gets faster. Be careful though, as when it's repaired it will be as slow as before!
aether_legacy_05.lore.aether_legacy.zanite_ring: A ring which allows you to mine faster. It doesn't last for long, so use it wisely!
aether_legacy_05.lore.aether_legacy.zanite_shovel: One of Aether's mid-tier tools, as you mine dirt and Quicksoil, the durability will decrease, and get faster. If you wait long enough it will start to break blocks instantly! Be careful repairing it, as it will be slower when there is more durability.
aether_legacy_05.lore.aether_legacy.zanite_sword: One of Aether's mid-tier tools, the attack damage on this sword starts at wood level, and will get to Diamond level when it's durability is low.
