evilcraft_02.info_book.evilcraft.first_age.items.dark: Using a &1Dark Gem&0 and a piece of &1Iron&0, I was able to create very sharp and durable &1Spikes&0. Mobs don't seem to like them very much...

Using some &1Iron&0, &1Dark Gems&0 and a piece of &1Glass&0, it is possible to construct a strong container that is able to hold fluids. It is possible to place these tanks somewhere, or hold them in your inventory.

When it is placed somewhere, you can right-click which gives it a purple-ish glow, and it seems to open up a hole at the bottom of the tank which is able to automatically fill tanks, item containers and players carrying containers underneath it.

Shift + right-clicking with the tank in your hand and not aiming at a block (because you know you will just place the tank down if you would do so) will enable a special mode to make it automatically try to fill any container you are currently holding if it can accept that fluid.

It looks like it can hold about sixteen buckets. If that is too limiting for you, these tanks seem to be expandable by placing multiple ones inside a crafting table, no fluids seem to go lost in this process.
evilcraft_02.info_book.evilcraft.first_age.items.disp: This small block can showcase your favorite items and blocks. It seems to support any wood type, and it can be placed with any rotation you want. You can pipe items in and out from the bottom or the top.
Interaction from all other sides of the block will be delegated to the item itself, so you can interact with its inventory, fluids, energy, ...
evilcraft_02.info_book.evilcraft.first_age.items.dull: Combining some &1Sugar&0 and &1Gunpowder&0 will result in a weird dust that doesn’t seem to be very useful at the moment, hence the name. Although this might change one day.
evilcraft_02.info_book.evilcraft.first_age.items.exal: Crafting tables can be inconvenient sometimes when at remote locations. It looks like the &1Crushed Dark Gems&0 give the power to craft things from within your inventory! Attaching some kind of chest to it gives an easy internal inventory, even your &1Ender Chest&0 seems to work. Power users might be happy with this item, since it can be bound to a hotkey. Using that same hotkey when the gui is open will clear your inventory, and using the hotkey with shift will balance all the items currently inside the grid. There is a toggle button available that allows you to switch between the return targets when shift-removing items from the crafting grid, you can choose between either the inner item inventory or your player inventory.
Striking it with lightning seems to make it bound to reality so that it can’t be destroyed or disappear when dropped.
evilcraft_02.info_book.evilcraft.first_age.items.obsc: Some people might find regular &1Glass&0 too bright. Combining some glass with a &1Dark Gem&0 seems to make a special type of glass that almost completely reduces the amount of light that gets through. I am still able to look through the glass though, very strange...
evilcraft_02.info_book.evilcraft.first_age.items.pote: Combining several shiny mundane items will result in a sphere that seems to possess some awesome powers, I might discover a way to harness these powers in the near future. It looks like the power can be inverted by using some &1Dark Gems&0.
evilcraft_02.info_book.evilcraft.first_age.items.spik: Some &1Spikes&0 and a &1Plate&0 will result in a plate which will damage any mob walking over it, me and my peers don’t seem to take any damage though. The powers of the &1Dark Gem&0 seems to ensure killing mobs in this process to drop the same things when killed by any player.
For your convenience, they also give off a redstone signal when a mob is taking damage.
Nothing is more annoying than swapping tools around when trying to break blocks, and the suddenly having to fight incoming mobs.
Combining some &1Spikes&0 allows you to break almost all soft materials very quickly. At the same time, any mobs that come creeping by can also be attacked with sufficient power.
Our world is made up of &1Biomes&0, many different variantions exist. Unfortunately, we can not choose the location of these &1Biomes&0, or at least not always.

One of the abilities of the &1Environmental Accumulator&0 is that it can accept special &1Biome Extract Bottles&0 which it can fill with the &1Biome&0 the machine is currently placed in. These bottles can be thrown anywhere on the ground to transform that area to the given biome.

One major disadvantage of the &1Environmental Accumulator&0 is that it will degrade its biome over time, so the bottles coming out of it will become pretty useless. If only there was an alternative way to craft these &1Biome Extracts&0 without bad effects...

This world is filled with all sorts of resources, this I have known for a long time... But today I have made a new discovery, there is an ore in this world, with a somewhat dark shine to it, it makes me think of precious gems, but I sense a very obscure presence within them. Hitting them with an iron pick axe seems to be the minimal requirement to get some of these gems. There also seems to appear some kind of rather strange dust, when I mine them, I’m sure I will find a use for this dust soon enough. It appears that Fortune levels increase the chance of getting these dusts.

There seem to be certain structures in this world that were built by some kind of ancient civilization that was able to infuse certain environmental powers into items. These processes however seem to degrade the natural balance of the environment the more this process is used. This is possibly the main reason why that civilization isn’t around anymore today...

Using &1Dark Gems&0 I was able to enhance existing &1Glass Bottles&0 to be able to contain environmental weather. Throwing such a &1Weather Container&0 inside the core of such a temple will absorb the current weather into the bottle.

I also discovered that certain items can be empowered using the special properties of thunderstorms. These items can also be empowered when they are directly struck by lightning, but it seems very unlikely to predict where lightning is going to strike, or is it...?
These temples seem emit some kind of energy, maybe I can find some way to detect this and discover new temples in the world?

As you are reading this book, you might have already come across this item. Combining an &1Apple&0 and a &1Dark Gem&0 results in a special &1Apple&0 that when eaten inflicts large amounts of damage for a certain time. If the entity dies because of this effect, it will leave behind some kind of anomaly. I have yet to discover any uses for this phenomenon...

While caving, I occasionally encounter these grim rooms with &4Blood&0 spread all over the floor. These &4Blood&0 traces are probably caused by the battles of previous explorers with the countless mobs inhabiting these dungeons.

I have discovered several strange new things lately. They all give off some eerie vibe, the longer I am around those things, the more I feel accustomed to it... Not all of these things might be very useful right away, but I might have some ideas to use them for something else.

It seems that there are some new creatures in this world. This creature appears to be a pretty large type of dragonfly. During the day time it is a rather peaceful creature, but do not be fooled, for if you would venture too close in proximity of this insect, it will try to poison you as though it being some kind of self defense. At night however, this beasty becomes subdued by an ancient evil and kills everything in its path. I deem myself lucky they have no other weapons besides actively looking me up at night to come and poison me. I managed to kill quite a few of these annoying things and carved some interesting poison sacs from their bodies. I have thrown them in a &1Bucket of Water&0 and the water really absorbs the poison well when I throw in four of these. I have long done the same with &lPoisonous Potato’s&r as well. It can be useful in a pinch for defending my evil lair... Ehm, I mean house... I named this creature after the dutch word for it’s kind, because I did not want to let it be confused with ordinary dragon flies, for obvious reasons...

Once upon a time while I was visiting hell, I discovered a block of &1Netherrack&0 that was a bit harder to break than normally. But after breaking the block, I noticed a little creature popping out and it started to attack me. It lit me on fire and I took some mild damage, luckily I was able to kill it without much trouble.

Weather that is contained in these bottles can be reactivated when the bottles are thrown against something. But instead of breaking them, it might be more interesting to use them to craft several other neat items.

Whilest I was exploring this world, I have taken rest in many villages. One of the towns I rested in had a strange looking fellow in it. I started talking to him and it soon struck me he was not as interested in emeralds as the other people in his town. In fact he started asking more and more questions about the dark ore I had discovered, we talked away hours and hours. He was so keen about getting his hands on them and other objects I have discovered that we ended up trading things for most of the rest of the day. When night had fallen, he took me to his house in the village and he said I was most welcome to spend the night in his spare bedroom. I said I already rented a room at the local inn but thanked him for his kindness anyway. As I crawled into bed in the inn, I took a last glance at the moon, as I usually do before going to sleep and I saw it was a nice full moon. As I closed my eyes, all of a sudden, I heard a loud distressed shout and after that a wolf-like growl. The whole village was looking through their windows and we saw a tall wolf, walking on its hindlegs. Everyone cowered in fear, but I, without fear nor doubt, took up my trusty dagger and gave it a pretty good beating. It was a very strong creature, his fur will make a nice memento to his great fight...When I woke up the next morning to conclude my trading session of the day before, my strange trading friend had taken a leave. There where claw marks all over his house and there was &4Blood&0 on the floor, I still wonder if the strange wolve ate him... Or if perhaps he was a werewolf, as the villagers gossip on... It looks like I can convert his drops to regular items when just placing them inside a &1Crafting Table&0.
evilcraft_03.info_book.evilcraft.first_age.relics.enc: &l&nCurse of Breaking&r&NThis enchantment exists in three stages, it looks like it does exactly the opposite of the Unbreaking enchant. This doesn’t seem very useful, does it? Maybe I should find a way to get rid of this.
&l&nLife Stealing&r&NThe three stages of this enchant on offensive weapons allows you to steal parts of the life you take from others.

&l&nPoison Tip&r&NWhen applying some poison to your weapons, you have a chance of poisoning your victims.This enchantment exists in three stages. It looks like you can make a basic version of this enchantment by adding a poisonous material to a regular book.

&l&nUnusing&r&NI was getting tired of my favorite tools breaking everytime I wasn’t paying attention to them. This I why I devised a new enchantment that makes tools unusable when they are about to break, giving myself enough time to repair it to its former glory.
&l&nCurse of Vengeance&r&NTools with this enchanment will spawn Vengeance Spirits when used.
evilcraft_03.info_book.evilcraft.first_age.relics.hum: You might never have noticed before, but when players die they seem to drop a part of their flesh. Eating it seems to be dangerous, maybe eating it at night-time might be more safe. I wouldn’t recommend eating your own flesh though, that’s just nasty, try eating one of your friends instead!
evilcraft_03.info_book.evilcraft.first_age.vengeance_: On some of my adventures I discovered some strange purple boxes which contained some distorted spirits. It looks like these spirits were captured a long time ago and have since been degrading, I don’t think they can be restored to their original state though.

I was able to reverse-engineer these boxes to be able to craft them myself. In this process, I also discovered how to freeze spirits so that they can be absorbed by these boxes. I enhanced the &1Vengeance Ring&0 with this technology to make a &1Vengeance Focus&0 that can be used to target spirits and catch them. Maybe I can use these contained spirits for something later...
Other people find it strange, but I always watch closely when beasts die. I noticed that they mostly give off some strange dark-purple aura which quickly fades again.

evilcraft_04.info_book.evilcraft.first_age.vengeance_: I noticed that I can use some of the &1Crushed Dark Gem&0 to construct a ring which allows me to fully see those auras of the mobs I kill, though it looks like they can see me as well. They always try to follow me and when they touch me they do some minor damage after which they dissolve into thin air.
Activating the ring gives me some amazing powers but this seems to attract and anger some spirits, although most of these spirits are unrecognisable for some reason...

These spirits can do some nasty damage if you’re not careful. I noticed that these spirits seem to be annoyed by &1Dark Gems&0, but they still ignore feeling that if they see you. The power of fire and a larger amount of &1Dark Gems&0 seems to change the way the spirits attack you though. Instead of taking damage, you will now only be a bit more hungry, which might be better than the alternative.

A completely different alternative to spirit protection, is to simply make yourself invisible to these spirits. It looks like the &1Spectral Glasses&0 allow you to see any spirit without them being able to see you, unless they were already out for your soul. This does however require some otherwordly material to craft, maybe I'll come across it later.
evilcraft_04.info_book.evilcraft.preface.text1: It would seem this world holds more than meets the eye. There are things I will conclude in this book, my writings of acquired knowledge of the obscurity that resides here. I have discovered a dark way of living with the creatures of this world. “&oWhat evil will come of this&r”, I ask myself? “&oEvil lurks in every corner&r”, I hear a dark voice within me reply. I have discovered a few secrets within this vast world of silly villagers and zombies, something their puny minds will never comprehend.
evilcraft_04.info_book.evilcraft.preface.text2: Many kinds of magic exist in this world, but the kind you can achieve with &4Blood&0 seems different. I've noticed people cutting themselves for obtaining &4Blood&0, I prefer to spare my strength for some other things...
evilcraft_04.info_book.evilcraft.second_age.abusing_s: Having &1Vengeance Spirits&0 contained in boxes is not very useful by itself. I theorized that it might be possible to revive the spirits using some &4Blood&0...

I finally succeeded in reviving &1Vengeance Spirits&0, or at least partially. The revived spirits seem to be too weak to live in the real world, but they seem to have all the properties and materials of real mobs though. There is however a use for this discovery, when building a large machine that can contain the resulting mob it will, at the cost of a large amount of &4Blood&0, revive the spirit and immediately cook it alive. This will result in the drops of these mobs to be collected in the machine’s inventory. It looks like the &1Box of Eternal Closure&0 can indefinitely be reused without the spirit ever getting out of it.

You will need a bunch of tough blocks, like &1Dark Bricks&0 infused with some &4Blood&0 to make sure the spirits can’t get out. You will need to build a cubic structure of these blocks so that the mob you wish to reanimate has room enough to fit in the inside of the structure. A zombie for example is one block wide and two blocks high, so you will need a structure of three blocks wide and four blocks high with a hollow space inside. If the mob you try to contain is very large you might even need to build a structure that is as large as a nine-by-nine, not too shabby!

You will also need a single &1Spirit Furnace&0 block somewhere in the structure. This block can easily be connected to other inventories or tanks using the known means. You will see a distinct red glow when the structure has been successfully assembled.

After the discovery of the &1Spirit Furnace&0 I was still determined to revive those spirits. To solve the problem of unstable mobs I put them inside &1Eggs&0, as an attempt to stabilize them. This process still requires some substantial amount of &4Blood&0 and of course an empty &1Egg&0.
Because of this more advanced process, spirits will be completely used up, so only one &1Egg&0 can be created per &1spirit&0.
Some mobs however seem to refuse to enter the &1Egg&0, so their spirits will be lost forever.
evilcraft_04.info_book.evilcraft.second_age.after_dea: What if it was possible to imbue the darkest thoughts and emotions into this world. This could prove to be an immense source of unimaginable power. With the discovery of vengeance, darkness and blood, I think I may have the essential elements.
Combining these elements resulted in a strange spiritual energy. It is so otherwordly, that it does not have its own material, which is why it is observed as some kind of creamed corn.
My subjects say I have gone too far with this, the fools.

After handling spirits one after the other, I became quite comfortable with being among them. Because of that, I was able to notice some of their specific traits, and even fears! They seem to dislike anything having to do with 'endings' in any form.

I was always annoyed by the fact that those nasty spirits could attack me, and there was nothing I could do against them. That is why I investigated a way to damage them. It looks like their fear of endings was grounded, because those things damage them. Using some 'end'-relics, I was able to transform my &1Vengeance Focus&0 to an improved version which is able to damage them.

This new focus appeared to be strong enough to completely 'kill' any spirit. But to my suprise, they drop some stuff. This includes some things that their old physical form carried and also some ghastly dust, which seems to carry the spirits' darkest parts and may prove useful in the future...
evilcraft_04.info_book.evilcraft.second_age.blood_ext: Using some &1Spikes&0, I was able to make a simple utility to obtain some &4Blood&0 from various places. When killing certain beasts, this item will fill up with &4Blood&0 when it is somewhere within your inventory. Sometimes you might come across some &4Blood&0 stains on the ground, a simple shift + right click will put some of the &4Blood&0 in your extractor. These &4Blood&0 stains seem to form when something falls to death from a great height, this might come in handy one day...
A simple right click with this item will place one bucket of &4Blood&0 on the ground.
This will be useful until I find some less manual ways to get my hands on some &4Blood&0.

By default, the size of these extractors are a bit limited. But it looks like I can just combine multiple &1Blood Extractors&0 inside a crafting grid to increase the capacity, it can even be combined with &1Dark Tanks&0 for even more storage capacity.
evilcraft_04.info_book.evilcraft.second_age.blood_inf: Soon after my first &1Blood Infuser&0 was built, I started to think of some optimizations to make the machine faster and more efficient. Using the &1Crushed Dark Gems&0 I was able to construct materialized &1Promises&0 which the &1Blood Infuser&0 actually seems to adhere to, it looks like the machine is actually alive in some way...

evilcraft_05.info_book.evilcraft.second_age.blood_inf: Filling a &1Bowl of Empty Promises&0 with this purple powder and infusing it with &4Blood&0 will result in a &1Bowl of Promises&0 of a certain strength. Combining this with a reactant and a mineral promise acceptor which can be created with a significant amount of &4Blood&0, will result in a &1Promise&0 of a certain type. &1Promises of Tenacity&0 can be created by utilizing organic reactants, this will allow the machine (and maybe others as well) to allow for more &1Promises&0 and &4Blood&0 to hold, furthermore, it increases the possible infusion recipes. &1Promises of Velocity&0 can be used to increase the speed of the machine, while the &1Productivity Promise&0 will reduce the amount of &4Blood&0 required to process an item.
Because of these new &1Promises of Tenacity&0, it looks like a whole new world opened to infuse items.

My first simple attempt to infuse items with &4Blood&0 resulted in a simple chest in which tools can bathe in. This bathing causes damage to the tools to slowly disappear. There is however a minor issue which causes tools to rarely attain bad effects, like the &1Curse of Breaking&0 enchant. I’ll certainly discover another way to purify these tools to get rid of these bad effects.

After repairing items, I was sure I could take things to the next level. Items that can accept &4Blood&0, like the &1Dark Tanks&0 I introduced before, will be filled with &4Blood&0 when placed in this machine. Other specific items seem to transform in a special way when filled with &4Blood&0, here is a non-exhaustive list of items which can be infused. Giving this machine a redstone signal will pause any running process.
This machine finally allows you to make &1Dark Power Gems&0 more easily and at a much lower cost.

This is one of the most profound discoveries based on &4Blood&0. Mundane items can be infused with &4Blood&0 to give the very special and interesting properties. The possibilities are endless, as long as you are not afraid to think a bit out of the box.

I was able to reanimate dead saplings, the trees that grow from this process are remarkable to say the least. They seem to give off a lot of Blood, but the saplings that drop still seem to be dead somehow. Combining the wood with a Dark Gem will result in some sticks which will be useful some day.
Killing a sapling is as simple as shearing a living one in a crafting grid. &oIs that tree growing in a desert?&r
Dropping sticks made from this wood always seems to rotate in a certain direction. Could it be pointing to somewhere?
evilcraft_05.info_book.evilcraft.second_age.evolved_b: When you have as much experience as I have with infusing items with &4Blood&0, you will notice that by enhancing a tear of the fearsome &1Ghast&0 will result in a very special kind of tear. It seems to share all properties when split in half. This gave me the idea to build &lEntangled Chalices&0 with this tear with the goal of sharing the fluid contents of the chalice with all other chalices that are constructed from the same tear.

Normally, you will get two chalices sharing contents from the crafting recipe, but when replacing the center &4Gold Ingot&0 in the recipe with an existing chalice, it will expand the tear network to include another chalice.

These chalices can be placed in the world or held in your inventory. Shift + right-click with it in your hand to enable the Omni-Supply mode which will continuously try to fill all containers in your inventory with &4Blood&0.

After the unfortunate side-effects of the &1Blood Chest&0, I decided to design a new machine that is able to remove these bad effects from your tools. Simply by placing a tool with a bad effect inside of this block together with at least one bucket worth of &4Blood&0 will remove this effect from the item.

An unintended benefit of this machine is that when filling it completely with &4Blood&0 and placing an enchanted item together with a &1Blook&0 (which is just a &1Book&0 infused with &1Blood&0), will move a random enchantment from the item to the book, at the cost of three &1Buckets of Blood&0.

Recently, I noticed that this machine also allows you to remove &1Potion Effects&0 from living creatures sitting inside of it by filling the &1Purifier&0 completely with &4Blood&0 and giving it an &1Empty Bottle&0. After a few seconds, the effect will be contained inside the bottle and the creature will be freed of it.

I was getting tired of pushing mobs off of cliffs and extracting the &4Blood&0, that is why I constructed a device which is able to extract &4Blood&0 from nearby stained blocks and place it in any nearby tanks. Using some &1Dark Power Gems&0, the &4Blood&0 efficiency of this &4Blood&0 extraction can be increased.
Placing a &1Spiked Plate&0 on top of it will enhance the capabilities of this plate to also absorb the &4Blood&0 of the beasts it kills and redirect it to the pedestal.
evilcraft_05.info_book.evilcraft.second_age.powers_of: Everyone knows that &4Blood&0 is a key element of every living being. Combining the magical properties of &1Dark Gems&0 and the vitalizing &4Blood&0 allowed me to come up with some really amazing new tools and machines. Some of my peers say I’m a bit too enthusiastic about this discovery, I guess they’re not open-minded enough.

&1Dark Gems&0 seem to be very open to accept &4Blood&0. Tossing one in a pool of &4Blood&0 results in a &1Dark Power Gem&0. Note that you will need at least five source &4Blood&0 blocks, you will need to do this at least once, in the next chapter I will explain how to more cheaply craft &1Dark Power Gems&0.

As we all know, &4Blood&0 will dry out after a while when it is in a dry area. Breaking the &1Hardened Blood&0 with a pickaxe or your fists will turn it into regular &4Blood&0 again. Using some &1Flint and Steel&0 on such &1Hardened Blood&0 will give some &1Hardened Blood Shards&0 which might come in handy later on. It looks like these shards can also be obtained when cooking such a &1Hardened Blood&0 block, if you can obtain it in some way ... maybe a soft touch can help?
It appears that &1Condensed Blood&0 can be found in some rare places. These can be inserted into any &4Blood&0-accepting machines to gain half a bucket of extra &4Blood&0 for your pleasure.
evilcraft_05.info_book.evilcraft.second_age.tools.blo: Regular &1Ender Pearls&0 are fun for teleporting around, but this can get quite expensive. Using the powers of &4Blood&0, I was able to construct a special &1Ender Pearl&0 that is completely reusable at the cost of some &4Blood&0. It also seems much more potent than regular &1Ender Pearls&0, which can only be good.
evilcraft_05.info_book.evilcraft.second_age.tools.bro: &1Brooms&0 are typically used to clean the floor. I noticed however, that by creating them using &1Crushed Dark Gems&0 and &1Dark Sticks&0, and infusing them with a constant stream of &4Blood&0, they seem to gain some very interesting qualities. When handling a &1Broom&0 in a certain way, it seems to float. After practicing with it for a while, I was able to control it enough to be able to fly in any direction I wanted while sitting on it.

evilcraft_06.info_book.evilcraft.second_age.tools.bro: &1Brooms&0 are made of three main parts. The &1Rod&0 is the basis of your broom, this will influence its main properties. A &1Brush&0 is needed to make the Broom maneuvarable. Finally, a &1Cap&0 is needed to balance your &1Broom&0.

All possible &1Broom&0 parts must be created using the &1Bare Rod, Brush&0 and &1Cap&0, this can be done by combining these three parts of any material in any crafting grid. Parts made from different materials seem to have different properties. All possible properties will be explained in the following section after that I will give an overview of all &1Broom&0 parts.
When flying with the &1Broom&0, make sure that it has enough &4Blood&0 at all times, otherwise the &1Broom&0 will slow down significantly.
&l&nAcceleration&r&NThe higher this value, the faster the &1Broom&0 will accelerate.
&l&nBouncy&r&NColliding entities will be bounced away, depending on this modifier value.
&l&nDamage&r&NThe damage that will be afflicted onto colliding mobs. The faster the &1Broom&0 is flying, the higher this damage will be.
&l&nEfficiency&r&NA higher modifier value will result in a higher chance that nood &4Blood&0 needs to be consumed.
&l&nFlame&r&NAny colliding entity will be lit on fire.
&l&nHungerer&r&NColliding entities will experience sudden hunger.
&l&nIcy&r&NSlows down colliding entities.

In this section, I will list all modifier effects I have discovered during my adventures. They can be applied to an existing &1Broom&0 by combining it in any crafting grid. Once the modifier is applied, there is no way to remove it again from the &1Broom&0.
&l&nKamikaze&r&NWhen colliding with an entity the &1Broom&0 will explode. It is very unlikely that a mounted player would survive something like this.
&l&nLevitation&r&NThe higher this value, the faster the &1Broom&0 can fly up.
&l&nLuck&r&NThis ability makes the mounted player more lucky when killing mobs and breaking blocks.
&l&nManeuverability&r&NHow fast a &1Broom&0 can rotate.
&l&nModifier Count&r&NThe maximum amount of modifiers a &1Broom&0 can have.
&l&nParticles&r&NHow much particles should be emitted from the &1Broom&0 when flying.
&l&nSmash&r&NThis is used to enable the &1Broom&0 to break blocks when flying. Higher values can break harder blocks.
&l&nSpeed&r&NThe top speed of a &1Broom&0.
&l&nThoughness&r&NHigher modifier values will make the &1Broom&0 less influencable by external factors during movement.
&l&nSwimming&r&NThis makes the &1Broom&0 better maneuverable in liquids.
&l&nWitherer&r&NThe wither effect will be applied to colliding entities.
&l&nWither Shield&r&NThe higher the modifier value, the larger the chance that the mounted player will be protected from incoming projectiles.
Various materials can be used to make broom parts. Their tooltip shows what base modifiers will be present on the resulting &1Broom&0 after crafting.
evilcraft_06.info_book.evilcraft.second_age.tools.eff: I was able to construct a special ring that can apply the &1Promises&0 of &Productivity&0 and &1Velocity&0 which allows you to walk faster, jump higher and step more easily on blocks. Just hold this item anywhere inside your inventory to gain its effects. Note that this step assist can be avoided by holding &oShift&r.
evilcraft_06.info_book.evilcraft.second_age.tools.gem: I was able to combine the &1Burning Gemstone&0 with a &1Dark Stick&0 to make a special torch that seems to absorb any spawning &1Vengeance Spirits&0 in its light area. Note that any spirits spawned outside the area will still be able to wander in this area though, but a simple mundane wall should be able to solve that.
evilcraft_06.info_book.evilcraft.second_age.tools.int: Items that use &4Blood&0 mostly have an internal container that can hold some &4Blood&0 which can be filled using the &1Blood Infuser&0 or by activating auto-supply mode on other tools and holding the item to fill in your hand. When using these items, it will drain some &4Blood&0. When that item has ran out of &4Blood&0, it will try to drain &4Blood&0 from other containers in your inventory, or it will stop functioning if no such item can be found.
evilcraft_06.info_book.evilcraft.second_age.tools.inv: Getting rid of bad potion effects can be a pain. This pendant is able to remove any bad effect at the cost of some &4Blood&0. Worse effects cost more &4Blood&0. It even seems to extinguish fire, but I wouldn’t recommend swimming in lava just yet. You will need a special kind of string to craft this, which can be created by combining regular string with a small fragment of gold.
evilcraft_06.info_book.evilcraft.second_age.tools.kin: This item is able to attract items and experience orbs in a certain area. This area can be changed by right-clicking it, enabling or disabling it is done with a simple shift + right-click. Items that are attracted from nearby consumes little to no &4Blood&0, but items from further away will require some more &4Blood&0. Sneaking will avoid kineticating items.
Reversing the recipe will give the opposite version of this item which is able to repel items and experience orbs.
evilcraft_06.info_book.evilcraft.second_age.tools.pri: After making the &1Invigorating Pendant&0, I started thinking. What if it would be possible to not only remove, but also apply effects? This new pendant is able to hold one &1Potion&0, and by using &4Blood&0 it will continuously apply its effect to you. I noticed that some effects cost more &4Blood&0 than the others. You can insert new &1Potions&0 by simply right-clicking with the item.
evilcraft_06.info_book.evilcraft.second_age.tools.sce: I feel oddly at peace when there are thunderstorms. That is why I made a simple tool that can spawn such storms. This item can however be used only once, making this a rather expensive process.
evilcraft_06.info_book.evilcraft.second_age.tools.ven: I’ve discovered a way to reuse the technology from the &1Vengeance Ring&0 into a pickaxe. This seems to drastically reduce the durability of the pickaxe though. But it has an interesting side-effect that when crafted will have the ability to trigger an enormous &1Fortune&0.
evilcraft_06.info_book.evilcraft.second_age.weapons.m: This is a variant of the &1Mace of Distortion&0, the force that is released by this mace is actually a powerful explosion. The longer you charge the mace, the bigger the explosion will be. Increasing the power level of this mace will increase the starting power of the explosion, so you can charge even more.

Holding right-click with this mace will build up a circular sphere around it that, when released, will trigger a force upon all other entities within that sphere knocking them back and causing some damage as long as the mace has enough &4Blood&0. Shift + right-clicking it will cycle through the different power levels, each higher level will cause more damage, but at the same time cost more &4Blood&0.

evilcraft_07.info_book.evilcraft.second_age.weapons.n: &1Zombies&0 seem to be controllable once you have a skull of some kind. After mounting such a skull on a staff I discovered that I can spawn zombies that will attack any entity I target for a limited amount of time.
evilcraft_07.info_book.evilcraft.second_age.weapons.v: Short on &4Blood&0 and always out in the fields attacking mobs? Why not use this sword that will boost the &4Blood&0 you will get in your &1Blood Extractor&0 after killing mobs? As a bonus, this sword will provide a default &1Looting&0 bonus when crafted.
evilcraft_07.info_book.evilcraft.structure.text1: This book is split into two major parts, for the two ages of evilness I like to classify everything in. I consider everything before my coming to this world as the &1First Age&0, and my life's work the &1Second Age&0.
evilcraft_07.info_book.evilcraft.structure.text2: You can navigate through this book by clicking on the arrows at the bottom, shift clicking will flip through whole sections instead of single pages. At the start of large sections you will see a content table which will contain hyperlinks to its subsections for faster browsing. When you come across recipes, the items that are explained in this book are clickable as a fast reference to the section they are explained in. You will also notice a button at the top left of this book, which will take you to the section above your current one. The button at the top right corner will go back to the previously visited page each time when clicked.
evilcraft_07.info_book.second_age.evolved_blood_machi: &1Blood Chests&0 are great, throw in your damaged stuff, and they come out repaired. One downside of using that machine is the occasional bad effect your items can get, and it can be quite annoying to continuously clear that effect with your &1Purifier&0.

Actually, the disadvantes don't stop there. The &1Blood Chests&0 has a very small inventory to put your items in, it is slow, has a small tank size and is really slow. Worst of all, my &1Promises&0 can't even be used to boost the machine!

That is why I created the &1Colossal Blood Chest&0! It solves all of the problems I have mentioned As a logical consequence, this machine is quite a bit bigger than its regular variant. Because of this massive size, I had to make use the strange powers of &1Undead Planks&0 to be able to hold the structure together.

This &1Colossal Blood Chest&0 should only be used if you have a lot of items you need to repair at once. The reason for this is that its base &4Blood&0 usage is higher than the usage of the &1Blood Chests&0, but the more items that are being repaired simultaneously, the more efficient this &4Blood&0 usage becomes.

To build this, make a &1hollow&0 3x3x3 structure of &1Reinforced Undead Planks&0. For the structure to form, your need exactly one &1Colossal Blood Chest&0 block somewhere in the structure wall, make sure not to place it in the middle of the structure, as it must remain hollow.

I was getting tired of running to &1Dark Temples&0 every time I had to accumulate some environment to craft new items. One day, I was so tired of it that I just broke one the machines standing in there, and to my suprise it dropped a strange new item.

After some research, I was able to use this new item in a new kind of &1Environmental Accumulator&0 that is able to run on &4Blood&0. I was also able to make this machine completely bad-effect proof, so no more biome degradation or random deaths by walking near those temples.

This machine requires a hefty amount of &4Blood&0 to work, that is why you will need &18&0 &4Blood&0 tanks of any type spread around the machine as can be seen in the following image. This machine will not work without those tanks, smoke effects can be seen at the locations where the tanks are supposed to be placed.
evilcraft_07.info_book.second_age.tools.rejuvenated_f: &1Flesh&0 can be combined with &1Garmonbozia&0 to make it an infinite source of food. You will however need to supply it with &4Blood&0 to be able to eat from it.

astralsorcery_01.astralsorcery.constellation.aevitas.cape: Bathed in the power creation, you find your hunger recovers with an emanated aura of healing. Furthermore, plants twist to your essence when within close proximity, changing into others of their kind.
astralsorcery_01.astralsorcery.constellation.aevitas.effe: Being exposed to focused light of this Constellation will flowers and plants nearby to flourish and greatly increase their bounty.
astralsorcery_01.astralsorcery.constellation.aevitas.ench: The light of creation accelerates new growth from injury, mending equipment and greatly healing the living.
astralsorcery_01.astralsorcery.constellation.aevitas.ritu: The ritual suffuses the area with an invigorated lifeforce - all nearby living entities experience regeneration, while nearby crops flourish and grow at an accelerated rate.
astralsorcery_01.astralsorcery.constellation.alcara.effec: All things in the universe have their own subtle harmony to them. The light of this Constellation corrupts those vibrations, twisting them to other ends.
astralsorcery_01.astralsorcery.constellation.alcara.encha: Resonant vibrations in tools cause blocks to more easily separate from their surroundings, and fish of the sea are drawn to them. Drinkers see themselves fade from view as their body vibrates against light itself.
astralsorcery_01.astralsorcery.constellation.alcara.trait: Instilling symbiotic resonance can greatly increase the power of a note. The slightest discordant infection can corrupt even the most beautiful of sounds, however.
astralsorcery_01.astralsorcery.constellation.armara.capee: A mantle infused with this Constellation's light will slowly collect it over time, manifesting into protective barriers which can completely deflect attacks for as long as the barrier remains.
astralsorcery_01.astralsorcery.constellation.armara.effec: A repulsive force pushes away from the light of this Constellation, much like a shield or protective barrier.
astralsorcery_01.astralsorcery.constellation.armara.encha: The protective nature of this Constellation imbues potions to allow the consumer to resist harm, or imbues equipment to protect the wielder.
astralsorcery_01.astralsorcery.constellation.armara.ritua: Channeling the repulsive forces that emit from this light into the near area creates a small force field, reflecting projectiles and pushing mobs outside its range.
astralsorcery_01.astralsorcery.constellation.bootes.capee: Wearing a mantle attuned to this Constellation causes Flares to flock to you, following you in your travels and aiding you in combat.
astralsorcery_01.astralsorcery.constellation.bootes.effec: These dim rays keep animals content and interested.
astralsorcery_01.astralsorcery.constellation.bootes.encha: Tools exposed to this light causes rage to temper while held, as blocks can be harvested with more care. Imbibing a potion instilled with this Constellation's light will have their hunger satiated for a while, preserving animal life.
astralsorcery_01.astralsorcery.constellation.bootes.ritua: When exposed to this spectrum of Starlight, animals close to it seem to relax and become fecund, but strangely ooze resources.
astralsorcery_01.astralsorcery.constellation.discidia.cap: Once infused with this Constellation's light, a mantle will draw strength from your enemies' blows, empowering your own against them. Once hit, the wearer gains a portion of the damage taken as additional damage to be dealt with each hit.
astralsorcery_01.astralsorcery.constellation.discidia.eff: Light from this Constellation seems to be unstoppable, piercing both materials and creatures alike.
astralsorcery_01.astralsorcery.constellation.discidia.enc: The violent nature of this Constellation saturates potions to grant strength to the consumer, or sharpens tools and empowers bows.
astralsorcery_01.astralsorcery.constellation.discidia.rit: Dispersing the strong light into small discordant energies in the area creates a damaging field, lashing out at all enemies nearby.
astralsorcery_01.astralsorcery.constellation.evorsio.cape: This infused cloak enhances your destructive potential, allowing you to break down walls with ease and severely damage hoards of enemies when one of them dies from your hand while in proximity to others.
astralsorcery_01.astralsorcery.constellation.evorsio.effe: Shattering and destructive; the piercing light of this Constellation forces its way even through most solid materials.
astralsorcery_01.astralsorcery.constellation.evorsio.ench: Tools bathed in the light of this Constellation more easily perform their intended tasks, and a drinker of this light gains a destructive efficiency to their actions.
astralsorcery_01.astralsorcery.constellation.evorsio.ritu: Dispersing the light of this Constellation in its focused essence with a ritual causes thorough destruction, and disintegrates any solid blocks nearby.
astralsorcery_01.astralsorcery.constellation.fornax.capee: While wearing the likeness of these stars, fire regenerates your flesh rather than scorching it. Furthermore, while also wearing flame itself, the heat is channeled into the ground you stand on: either burning or melting it down entirely.
astralsorcery_01.astralsorcery.constellation.fornax.effec: A strong force and intense heat follow closely to this Constellation's light. Looking at it makes you feel uncomfortably warm.
astralsorcery_01.astralsorcery.constellation.fornax.encha: Wielding tools that were directly exposed to these strong rays is very uncomfortable, and everything you strike or mine burns away before you. However, drinking potions imbued with this light seem to imbue you with fire instead.
astralsorcery_01.astralsorcery.constellation.fornax.ritua: Carefully distributing the energies of this Constellation over an area prevent it from setting fires, but the sustained heat will cause nearby blocks to become molten or burn.
astralsorcery_01.astralsorcery.constellation.gelu.effect: The cold depths of the Astral seem a perfect match for this chilly Constellation's supernatural powers.
astralsorcery_01.astralsorcery.constellation.gelu.enchant: The supernatural cold freezes water, condenses air to slow your fall, and makes tools harder to break. It provides protection from fire when consumed as a liquid.
astralsorcery_01.astralsorcery.constellation.gelu.trait: As the insidious cold diminishes output with it's deep chill, so too does it spread wide its embrace.
astralsorcery_01.astralsorcery.constellation.horologium.c: Wearers of a mantle attuned to time are able to freeze everything nearby when being attacked or in a dangerous situation. There is a delay before time can be so abruptly disturbed again, however. Due to Starlight interactions with Fornax, fire damage will not trigger this effect.
astralsorcery_01.astralsorcery.constellation.horologium.e: This Constellation seems to shift in time. Not only is finding it difficult, but its rays seem to twist time, causing things they shine upon to act much faster than usual.

Warped and twisted in time, harvesting things with tools that were even just briefly exposed to this Constellation's light yield far more resources than usual. Potions on the other hand grant the drinker increased speed in all things.
astralsorcery_01.astralsorcery.constellation.horologium.r: This ritual materializes the Constellation's affinity for things mechanical and ticking, where machinery nearby works at an increased pace.
astralsorcery_01.astralsorcery.constellation.lucerna.cape: Simply wearing a mantle infused with this Constellation's light will unsettle mobs around you, revealing their location. Areas where mobs may be summoned in great numbers by magical cages see exceptional reactions.
astralsorcery_01.astralsorcery.constellation.lucerna.effe: The light of this Constellation seems immensely bright despite it being far away. Bright enough that it may inhibit enemies from arising entirely in its area.
astralsorcery_01.astralsorcery.constellation.lucerna.ench: Imbibing the light of this Constellation temporarily banishes the darkness from the drinker's eyes. Bathing a helmet in this light accomplishes the same effect, permanently.
astralsorcery_01.astralsorcery.constellation.lucerna.ritu: While only Starlight, the fundamental brightness contained within prevents hostile creatures from arising in the area.
astralsorcery_01.astralsorcery.constellation.mineralis.ca: A mantle infused with this Constellation finds itself drawn to sought materials, allowing the wearer to determine the nearby locations of the currently held block.
astralsorcery_01.astralsorcery.constellation.mineralis.ef: Standing in the light of this Constellation, the very stone of the world seems to glow strangely and its shape seems to change ever so slightly over time.
astralsorcery_01.astralsorcery.constellation.mineralis.en: Also known as the "Coal Miner's Cure", those who drink a potion exposed to Mineralis report greater fortune in their endeavors; the same result has been observed in tools equally exposed.
astralsorcery_01.astralsorcery.constellation.mineralis.ri: Igneous processes are accelerated within nearby stone, resulting in new mineral growth where previously there was none.

astralsorcery_02.astralsorcery.constellation.octans.capee: A mantle infused with this Constellation makes the wearer as one with water; protecting from knockback attacks, granting underwater breathing, and allowing handling of tools like there was no water at all.
astralsorcery_02.astralsorcery.constellation.octans.effec: Reflecting this Constellation's light onto water makes it softly bubble, and sea life seems much more abundant under it's rays.
astralsorcery_02.astralsorcery.constellation.octans.encha: Helmets exposed to Octans provide oxygen from the water to the wearer, and drinking this Constellation's light causes gills to grow for a short time.
astralsorcery_02.astralsorcery.constellation.octans.ritua: Powered by Starlight, this ritual attracts fish in nearby water blocks, allowing them to be easily harvested.
astralsorcery_02.astralsorcery.constellation.pelotrio.cap: A mantle infused with this Constellation's light will often manifest Starlight into animated tools, mimicking the wearer's behavior when breaking blocks with a pickaxe, chopping down trees with an axe, or even striking enemies with weapons.
astralsorcery_02.astralsorcery.constellation.pelotrio.eff: The irresistible and unnaturally impulsive rays of this set of stars are only visible during the darkest or brightest nights.
astralsorcery_02.astralsorcery.constellation.pelotrio.enc: Focusing these conjuring energies on a bow summons forth unlimited ammunition. The same energies summons vigor to anyone who drinks potions exposed to the Constellation's light.
astralsorcery_02.astralsorcery.constellation.pelotrio.rit: Immersing the nearby area in the diffused light of this Constellation conjurs all kinds of beings to life.
astralsorcery_02.astralsorcery.constellation.ulteria.effe: The light of this Constellation endures, even across the vast distances it travels, like an unstoppable otherworldly juggernaut.
astralsorcery_02.astralsorcery.constellation.ulteria.ench: Weapons and equipment bathed in the light of this constellation not only make the wearer more durable, but are themselves more durable. Drinking of this light can help you outlast the most devious of attacks.
astralsorcery_02.astralsorcery.constellation.ulteria.trai: Drawing in your available resources can result in fueling increased focus.
astralsorcery_02.astralsorcery.constellation.vicio.capeef: This Attunement eases the burdens of travel by reducing your weight enough to ride the currents of the wind, allowing you to fly like one would with an elytra.
astralsorcery_02.astralsorcery.constellation.vicio.effect: Bathing in the rays of this Constellation make everything feel slower, while seeming to make you faster in whatever you do.
astralsorcery_02.astralsorcery.constellation.vicio.enchan: The essence of this Constellation's light increases speed of the drinker, whereas boots imbued with its light reduce the speed of impacts with the ground.
astralsorcery_02.astralsorcery.constellation.vicio.ritual: This ritual improves the mobility of all within, allowing movement in ways not normally possible for those without wings.
astralsorcery_02.astralsorcery.constellation.vorux.effect: Light from this Constellation invokes rage and aggression in those bathed in it, even from the far depths of the Astral.
astralsorcery_02.astralsorcery.constellation.vorux.enchan: The best defense is an aggressive offense for wielders of equipment bathed in this light. Potions imbued with this Constellation are often nicknamed "Liquid Courage".
astralsorcery_02.astralsorcery.constellation.vorux.trait: Burning the candle at both ends may provide for more illumination, but it invites the following darkness all the faster.

integratedtunnels_04.info_book.integratedtunnels.concepts.tex: &lIntegrated Tunnels&r adds 3 part types for the different transport types, namely &oImporters&r, &oExporters&r and &oInterfaces&r.
Importers (blue) always try to pull from a target, to Interfaces (white) in the same network.
Exporters (orange) always try to push to a target, from Interfaces (white) in the same network. Items in this case will always transfer from left to right.
You could add multiple interfaces to your network, and assign priorities to specify which should be filled/emptied first.
Furthermore, you can also add multiple Importers and Exporter, again with relative priorities.
Using &lIntegrated Dynamics&r variables, you have to specify what items should be moved. If you want to keep it simple, and just move everything, simply use a blank &lVariable Card&r.

Note that if you have an autocrafting mod such as &lIntegrated Crafting&r installed, then you will be able to use the &oCraft&r setting in exporters. This will make it so that if an ingredient is not available for export, that it should be crafted.
integratedtunnels_04.info_book.integratedtunnels.energy.text1: Move energy over the network. Import energy into the network using &lEnergy Importers&r into &lEnergy Interfaces&r. Export energy from the network using &lEnergy Exporters&r from &lEnergy Interfaces&r.
integratedtunnels_04.info_book.integratedtunnels.fluid.text1: Move fluids over the network. Import fluids into the network using &lFluid Importers&r into &lFluidInterfaces&r. Export fluids from the network using &lFluid Exporters&r from &lFluid Interfaces&r.
integratedtunnels_04.info_book.integratedtunnels.introduction: &lIntegrated Tunnels&r is an extension to &lIntegrated Dynamics&r to transfer items, fluids and energy over &lIntegrated Dynamics&r networks.

You can use &lIntegrated Dynamics&r logic to configure filters, which can be as complex as you desire. &o"I want to send 3 enchantable pickaxes with a damage value less than 10 to this chest every tick"&r or &o"I want to fill this tank until it has 1000mB of oil, but only when my machine is working and if I have less than 10 iron ingots in this chest"&r No problem! &lIntegrated Tunnels&r can do that for you, and it will do it efficiently as well!
integratedtunnels_04.info_book.integratedtunnels.item.text1: Move items over the network. Import items into the network using &lItem Importers&r into &lItem Interfaces&r. Export items from the network using &lItem Exporters&r from &lItem Interfaces&r.
integratedtunnels_04.info_book.integratedtunnels.player.text1: Any experienced Minecrafter knows that the less you have to click, the better. With the &lPlayer Simulator&r, you can automate away a large part of this tedious clicking. It allows you to automate clicking with any hand and item. Advanced properties allow you to change things like click positions and so on.
integratedtunnels_04.info_book.integratedtunnels.tutorials.br: Make a &lVariable Card&r containing a reference to the &8Stone&0 item value. Place this inside a &lWorld Block Importer&r to break only Stone blocks. Also have a look at the various aspect properties to see if you can manage to silk touch the Stone to avoid receiving just Cobblestone.
integratedtunnels_04.info_book.integratedtunnels.tutorials.cl: All this clicking and such can be quite boring, why not let a &lPlayer Simulator&r do it for you? Start by crafting one, and insert a &lVariable Card&r containing a &oDiamond Sword&r to let it attack autonomously using &oDiamond Swords&r from your item network.
integratedtunnels_04.info_book.integratedtunnels.tutorials.dr: Place an empty &lVariable Card&r inside a &lWorld Item Exporter&r to drop all items from the network on the ground.
integratedtunnels_04.info_book.integratedtunnels.tutorials.ex: Export all enchantable items to the target inventory. This can be done using a certain &lOperator&r.
Read the number of items in the target inventory using an &lInventory Reader&r, and only move items until the total number of items is larger than &610&0.
integratedtunnels_04.info_book.integratedtunnels.tutorials.im: Place an empty &lVariable Card&r inside a &lItem Importer&r to import all items into the network from a target inventory.
Import all items a certain list to the target inventory. An item list can be created by reading it from any &lInventory Reader&r.
&oItem Importers&r will move items from the target towards one of the &oItem Interfaces&r. &oItem Exporters&r do the opposite, they will move items from any of the &oItem Interfaces&r to the target.
integratedtunnels_04.info_book.integratedtunnels.tutorials.in: &oInterfaces&r are parts that can be attached to &lCables&r. An item, fluid and energy version exists for them, which respectively connect to inventories, tanks and energy machines. &oInterfaces&r make the target accessible to the network.
This section contains several tutorials that help you to learn &lIntegrated Tunnels&r, the &lIntegrated Dynamics&r add-on for item, fluid and energy transfer.
integratedtunnels_04.info_book.integratedtunnels.tutorials.pi: Write a constant number &65&0 to a &lVariable Card&r, and place it inside a &lWorld Item Importer&r to pick up 5 items at a time from the target space.
integratedtunnels_04.info_book.integratedtunnels.tutorials.pl: Try creating a system using the &lWorld Block Exporter&r that only places wooden logs. Do this using the &lOredictionary Values&r operator to retrieve a list of all &ologWood&r oredictionary items.
integratedtunnels_04.info_book.integratedtunnels.tutorials.wo: Instead of dropping items in the world or picking them up, you can also break and place blocks using the &lWorld Block Importer&r and &lWorld Block Exporter&r. Various aspect properties allow you to change properties such as whether or not the blocks should be silk touched when breaking.

integratedtunnels_05.info_book.integratedtunnels.tutorials.wo: Simular to &oItem Importers&r and &oItem Exporters&r, &lWorld Item Importers&r and &lWorld Item Exporters&r can respectively pick up items from the world into your item network and place items into the world from your item network. Furthermore, these can also be used to interact with dropped items that have inventories, such as &oShulker Boxes&r.
The &lBlock World Importers&r and &lBlock World Exporters&r allow you to place blocks and break them. Various aspect properties such as silk touching are available.
integratedtunnels_05.info_book.integratedtunnels.world.energy: The &lEnergy World Importers&r and &lFluid World Exporters&r help you interact with entities that have an energy buffer, such as dropped batteries.
With &lFluid World Importers&r and &lFluid World Exporters&r, you can place fluid source blocks, pick them up and interact with entities that are a tank, such as dropped tank items. Various aspect properties exists to change things like whether or not a block update should be caused.
integratedtunnels_05.info_book.integratedtunnels.world.item.t: &lItem World Importers&r and &lItem World Exporters&r can be used to place items in the world, pick them up, and interact with entities that have an inventory, such as dropped Shulker Boxes and Donkeys. Various aspect properties exists to change things like dispensing, throw-velocity, pickup delay, pitch and yaw.

botania_01.botania.challenge.apothecaryRefill.desc: Create a system that automatically refills the Petal Apothecary if it's empty. Bonus points if the system can also automatically create flowers, given the components.
botania_01.botania.challenge.autoQuarry.desc: Create a mining quarry that digs for ores and stone underground. It should dig out chunks of land and output all of the mined resources, sorting them. Bonus points if it can relocate automatically after it's done with an area.
botania_01.botania.challenge.battery.desc: Create a Mana Battery, a system where mana enters one pool and comes out of another, with a good amount of pools as a buffer. Bonus points if the input or output can be changed.
botania_01.botania.challenge.boneMealFarm.desc: Create an automated farm that utilizes bone meal to quickly grow crops on demand. Bonus points if the Drum of the Wild isn't used.
botania_01.botania.challenge.cobbleGen.desc: Create an automated cobblestone generator and harvester. Bonus points if it also creates smooth stone without a furnace.
botania_01.botania.challenge.entropinnyumSetup.desc: Create a system that automatically crafts TNT and safely feeds it to an Entropinnyum flower, creating mana. Bonus points if the sand and gunpowder required for the TNT don't need to be put in manually.
botania_01.botania.challenge.flowerFarm.desc: Create an automated farm of all 16 colors of botania flowers. Bonus points if the flowers are sorted.
botania_01.botania.challenge.fullCropFarm.desc: Create a crop farm with all types of crops (wheat, carrot, potato, beetroot, melon, pumpkin, cocoa, and nether wart) that runs at full efficiency. Bonus points if the outputs are sorted.
botania_01.botania.challenge.kekimurusSetup.desc: Fully automate a Kekimurus, every part of the system must be automated and self-sustaining. Bonus points if only one crafty crate is used.
botania_01.botania.challenge.mobTower.desc: Create a tower style mob farm. Mobs must be sorted and put into specific chambers at the end. Spawners can be used. Bonus points if the farm functions at 100% efficiency without a player's interaction.
botania_01.botania.challenge.orechid.desc: Create a system that allows for the Orechid flower to be fully automated. Bonus points if the output is smelted and sorted.
botania_01.botania.challenge.potionBrewer.desc: Create a system that can make all types of brews automatically on demand. Bonus points if it keeps a set of incense always ignited in the player's base.
botania_01.botania.challenge.pureDaisy.desc: Completely automate the Pure Daisy. Bonus points if only one spreader is used and/or if the wood/stone input is also automated.
botania_01.botania.challenge.recordFarm.desc: Create a system that produces records through the death of creepers at the hand of skeletons. Bonus points if it doesn't require a player's presence.
botania_01.botania.challenge.reedFarm.desc: Create an automated sugar cane farm. Bonus points for not using pistons.
botania_01.botania.challenge.runeCrafter.desc: Create a system that can craft all runes on demand or keep them stocked. Every part of this system must be automated and self-sustaining, including the item inputs. Bonus points if only one Runic Altar block is used. You must be pretty crazy to try this one.
botania_01.botania.challenge.shulkMeNotSetup.desc: Create a system that allows for a Shulk Me Not to produce mana automatically, without any mana, items or entities coming from outside the system. Bonus points if no unnecessary mob infighting happens.
botania_01.botania.challenge.spectrolusSetup.desc: Create a system that feeds a Spectrolus, generating mana. Aside from raw mana, no items may be input from outside the system. Bonus points if it operates at 100% efficiency, never wasting any wool.
botania_01.botania.challenge.treeFarm.desc: Create an automated, self-sustaining tree farm. Bonus points if it can do multiple types of tree.
